**Compatibility Custody Repository Root Authority History Repair Capability**:
The recovery-only prebound gateway capability profile selected by the active Repository Recovery Tool Registry so one damaged recovery-custody History route can be repaired while the Root Authority and ordinary Secret Broker are unavailable. It binds the Authority, exact active Tool Registry and Bundle, both custody routes and gateway principals, conditional-write API/schema, maximum bytes, object-path grammar, generation semantics, two-job topology and deterministic fixtures. Two distinct last-certified custodians must use their Repository Root Disaster Recovery Credentials over one byte-identical repair Intent, and two independently fetched recovery jobs must agree on one fully fetched and verified good source, one exact target Object ID, and either typed `MISSING` or the complete observed corrupt target generation/length/digest. The writer may perform only conditional create-if-absent for `MISSING` or conditional replace of that exact corrupt generation; the other job may only read the exact source and target. Neither principal can list, delete, wildcard, choose another object, write Authority-native state, alter a witness, or exercise any ordinary Broker, Permit, Registry, Git or provider authority, and this disaster path requires no unavailable Root Boundary Permit. Both jobs fully read back and publish the same result through separate recovery routes; the repaired generation remains unusable until the exact assigned witness emits its Custody Repair Observation binding this Capability and both custodian/job results. Another witness, two custodians, both jobs, timeout or a newly invented observation cannot substitute; permanent loss of that witness leaves recovery blocked inside the old Authority. Exact Witness Permanent Loss Evidence may instead select a fresh Disaster Bootstrap from one fully valid route and the last otherwise proven Usable Head, but never validates the unobserved repaired generation or creates a substitute Observation. Zero verified good routes, changed target generation, job disagreement, missing witness, wider gateway scope or unpinned profile freezes recovery.
_Avoid_: Disaster administrator credential, root-history rewrite, list-capable repair role

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Readiness Drill**:
The permanent dual-route evidence of one full maximum recovery-infrastructure exercise under the exact active Recovery Tool Registry tuple. It binds both Tool Bundle fetches and matching fixtures; exact Candidate Ineligibility Set Schema/compound-root/page/non-membership/Candidate Component Index proof-set fixtures, Candidate Ineligibility Set Capacity Reserve boundary cases at counts 65,533 and 65,534, one-good-route Artifact Repair and zero-good-route rejection; Bootstrap Issuer Randomness Incident fixture behavior without a live third collision; fresh control-plane readback of both Unavailability Observer Profiles' actual accounts, administrators, network operators/providers, egress paths and mutable route controls; fresh provider-native readback of the active Capacity Reservation root tenant, mutable parent organization, root administrators and network control plane, including its disjointness from every exhausted predecessor tuple; timeout/unreadable classification as `INCOMPLETE` and confirmed overlap as permanent resource exhaustion; six freshness-valid Root Authority Observation Probe responses under the exact Observation Key set and deadline/skew contract covering both observers and all three healthy endpoints with equal mode, revision and Usable Head; live agreement from two of the three original Issuance Ledger replicas and absence of Bootstrap Issuer Randomness Incident, Issuer Ledger Integrity Incident or pending Committed Credential Containment Evidence; when a Resource Successor Standby exists, complete Standby qualification/maturity evidence, a fresh live Resource Successor Standby Drill under its own never-reused namespace and Reservation, and its current parent-isolation projection; one fresh never-reused Qualification Test Namespace and exclusive Capacity Reservation claim; before that claim, an incomplete preflight may retry with fresh Probe nonces and job identities without cleanup, but after claim every incomplete attempt must finish its exact inventory, cleanup and terminal path before a later attempt uses another fresh namespace; maximum Issuer `COMMITTED` Receipt with its precommitted Fence ID dual-route publication before delivery, four-terminal Receipt and Fence Conflict schema exercise with terminal publication before accepting the test result; generation-matched cleanup at the exact Cleanup Issue Schedule through both Credential Mutation Fence and Cleanup Fence Exemption Evidence fixture paths, including `NOT_DELIVERED` exact-terminal and no-commit live 2-of-3 Ledger branches, two-job/two-current-custodian byte agreement, Ledger-unavailable no-cleanup rejection, bounded Namespace Emptiness Mismatch and immediate Namespace Generation Integrity Incident/Namespace Generation Failure Domain handling; live invocation of the linearizable Exact-Generation Namespace Emptiness Assertion with both jobs returning the same generation token and no list fallback; one complete Qualification Namespace Absence Proof containing both the finite-manifest per-path readbacks and exact namespace-generation emptiness assertion; and Reservation return to `AVAILABLE`. The Drill reports Resource Successor Coverage separately: missing, immature or more-than-2,592,000-second-old Standby evidence yields `GAP` and blocks only a later resource-only recovery, not otherwise valid ordinary authority; any Standby identity, parent-isolation, Bundle, schema, Schedule or Assertion semantic change permanently fences it. On the active tuple, confirmed observer convergence/configuration drift, Clock Profile Drift, Observer Time-Basis Incident, Observation Disagreement, issuance-order violation, Bootstrap Issuer Randomness Incident, Issuer Ledger Integrity Incident, incomplete Committed Credential Containment Evidence, functional failure, cleanup quarantine, missing or eventual Exact-Generation Assertion, unequal same-issue tokens or uncaused read-only token change deriving Namespace Generation Integrity Incident whose exact Failure Domain contains the active tuple, Schedule disagreement, eighth namespace mismatch or evidence disagreement invalidates readiness and immediately blocks ordinary Permits. The same failure confined to the optional Standby Drill fences only that Standby, changes no Candidate state and derives Resource Successor Coverage `GAP`, unless the evidence also proves a shared dependency affects the active tuple; Observer Profile convergence requires a separately exercised Tool Registry successor while healthy, first-Authority Clock Profile Drift opens only its clean-key-and-History planned-Replacement lane, while repeated distinct-Authority drift under the same pair derives Observer Time-Basis Incident and blocks another candidate, and Observation Disagreement opens its narrow planned-Replacement lane only after complete independent History consistency proof. A timeout, unreadable observer control plane, temporary Observation Key outage, one-Observer skew violation, both-observer failure through one shared public CA/DNS dependency or incomplete Probe matrix makes that attempt `INCOMPLETE` and produces no new success, but does not invalidate a still-current prior successful Drill unless it also proves drift. While the Authority is healthy, the latest successful completion remains valid for no more than 2,592,000 seconds and may be followed by another attempt. Temporary Observation Key unavailability never becomes permanent incident evidence by elapsed time; once that prior success is stale, readiness stays blocked until the key recovers or irreversible loss/compromise evidence is available. If fresh evidence is required in locked recovery, any incomplete or failed attempt keeps recovery blocked until the exact active tuple completes a new successful Drill; an incident-time observer or Registry substitute is forbidden. After Observer Time-Basis Recovery, that Drill is eligible only after both fresh Observers have passed the full 86,400-second validation over every old, candidate and replacement-relevant Authority endpoint; drift against the first Authority routes to ordinary Clock Profile Drift, drift against a second distinct Authority under the unchanged pair creates a new Observer Time-Basis Incident, and missing or partial endpoint coverage stays incomplete. A Drill uses a fresh namespace, grants no production or candidate authority, cannot repair a failed candidate, and never permits a tuple, Ledger, observer or Reservation substitution. The Drill's authority fixtures additionally exercise the immutable Observer Recovery Relevant Endpoint Set, two consecutive wholly fresh pair-level incidents, the intervening-success reset and Observer Platform Trust Incident boundary-change requirement; permanent uncompacted Candidate and Standby-Drill transitions in the same Bootstrap Issuance Ledger; fresh Qualification Subject Identity uniqueness and exact checked-`u64` Issuance Ledger Capacity Reserve boundaries; daily Resource Successor Coverage alerts and audit-only Alert Acknowledgement; role-specific Candidate Component Canonicalization, one-good-route Component Index page repair, zero-good-route rejection and one-way Candidate Ineligibility Set Schema Successor activation; Candidate Randomness Cleanup Exhaustion without ordinal carry; in-scope historical credential use versus a blocking Broker Bootstrap Credential Scope Escape Incident; rejection of Cleanup Fence Exemption with fewer than two current custodians; and one atomic Namespace Generation Failure Domain Fence Record plus a concurrent-activation incident-index recheck. Observer fixtures preserve Observer Pair Failure Ancestry across trust roots, reject a root-change reset, and prove that Platform Trust recovery replaced and requalified host, mutable control plane and provider for both fresh Observers. The Drill also distinguishes Standby Coverage freshness from its own readiness freshness: a missed Standby Drill caused solely by Ledger rotation delay yields only Coverage `GAP`, while expiration of this core Drill still blocks ordinary Permits. Security fixtures distinguish historical in-scope use, post-final Containment Consistency Incident and out-of-scope Credential Scope Escape Incident; recompute the complete Credential Boundary Affected Authority Closure; and require Credential Boundary Security Recovery to replace and requalify every closure member before Policy. Observer fixtures verify the checked-`u64` Pair Failure Ancestry head/count, full-chain replay, prospective outcome reserve and pairwise/set-disjoint provider identities; account-only or region-only rotation is rejected. **Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Qualification Capacity Reservation**:
The no-TTL exclusive nonproduction capacity handle prequalified and pinned by one Repository Recovery Tool Registry generation to one exact root tenant, mutable parent organization, root-administrator set, network control plane, account and administrator set, endpoint, namespace root, quota generation, qualified Exact-Generation Namespace Emptiness Assertion semantic identity and atomic reservation primitive or exclusive fixed-slot class. Absence of that linearizable same-token Assertion makes the provider profile ineligible before Tool Registry activation; list, wildcard, administrator proof or deliberate later quarantine cannot substitute. A Resource Successor Standby's complete isolation projection is read live during each monthly Resource Successor Standby Drill, at activation, every Readiness Drill and immediately before its first Challenge. Timeout or unreadable state makes the check `INCOMPLETE`; confirmed shared mutable parent organization, root administrator or network control plane permanently makes the tuple `QUARANTINED_EXHAUSTED` and fences the Standby. Cached configuration never suffices. Its checked compiler output divides the handle into nonfungible `candidate_bytes` sufficient for one maximum generated first-Broker qualification run and `cleanup_proof_bytes` sufficient for every issuance, use, provider-qualified Cleanup Issue Schedule, at-most-eight-issue generation-matched cleanup chain and complete Qualification Namespace Absence Proof at that maximum. Before claim, an incomplete preflight or Drill observation may retry without cleanup because no namespace or capacity state exists. Exactly one live Root Recovery Qualification Challenge, Readiness Drill or healthy-authority Standby Drill may atomically claim it; the claim binds a fresh Qualification Test Namespace beneath that root and cannot share, pool, borrow, overcommit, resize, renew, migrate or allocate cleanup capacity later. After claim, every incomplete attempt, including a `RANDOMNESS_ABORTED` Challenge, must complete its exact Cleanup Fence Exemption Evidence, inventory, cleanup, Qualification Namespace Absence Proof, Reservation release and terminal path before another attempt, whose namespace is always fresh. Complete cleanup under a valid Fence or Cleanup Fence Exemption Evidence and a valid Qualification Namespace Absence Proof normally return the same handle to `AVAILABLE` while permanently retaining compact proof; for delivery uncertainty, however, even an early Fence and complete cleanup leave it `QUARANTINED` until credential expiry and dual-route publication/readback of the `DELIVERY_UNKNOWN_EXPIRED` terminal Receipt. Any other uncertainty or present object makes it `QUARANTINED`; `FENCE_CONFLICT` immediately and permanently makes its account/root/Namespace/Reservation `QUARANTINED_EXHAUSTED`, while Namespace Generation Integrity Incident does so for every claimed resource in its exact Namespace Generation Failure Domain; neither permits cleanup or release, and the Incident invalidates a Candidate only if credential delivery or execution began; after its Resource Successor Barrier activates the exact matured and freshly exercised Resource Successor Standby, a fresh Reservation may support only a different Candidate Identity with checked Candidate Ineligibility Set non-membership, complete Candidate Component Index proof set and a Remediation Claim covering every overlapping barred identity in a remaining slot of the same Receipt. Only the exact Root Recovery Qualification Cleanup Capability, its Fence or Fence Exemption Evidence and fixed Issue Chain may delete the observed generations and produce that Absence Proof before returning capacity, and success never revives the failed candidate, Drill or namespace. An unresolved eighth issue changes the handle to permanent `QUARANTINED_EXHAUSTED`: locked recovery remains blocked. While the Authority is healthy, the Tool Registry may propose and fully qualify one `PENDING` Resource Successor Standby and mature it only after 86,400 seconds. During incomplete recovery, readiness can return through the narrow `root_recovery_governance` resource-successor lane only by activating that exact matured and freshly exercised Standby after the Resource Successor Barrier proves all old issuance terminal, evidence deterministic and old capabilities inert. That exact matured and freshly exercised Standby selects a fresh namespace root and Reservation in a new independently controlled root tenant/account whose mutable parent organization, root administrator and network control plane are disjoint from the old tuple and every Issuer, candidate, Observer and recovery-job administrator; the same provider is allowed only with that independent boundary; a different provider additionally requires byte-identical already-qualified Bundle, schema, Cleanup Issue Schedule and Exact-Generation Namespace Emptiness Assertion semantic identities. Activation consumes that Standby's recovery role and leaves Resource Successor Coverage `GAP` until the newly active healthy Registry qualifies and matures another Standby; ordinary work may continue while other checks pass. It retains the exact same healthy Bootstrap Issuer and Ledger identity, original replicas, revision and complete state; every Candidate Attempt Chain continues, while the old account/root/handle remain permanently quarantined evidence and are never migrated, reconciled or reused. Free-space observation, ordinary Admission, production quota, administrator cleanup, a shared test account or an unreserved retry cannot substitute. Permanent post-`RANDOMNESS_ABORTED` cleanup, Absence-Proof or release failure derives Candidate Randomness Cleanup Exhaustion, permanently consumes the Candidate chain and Receipt slot and never permits ordinal carry or Reservation reuse; another full ceremony may proceed only after the successor Ineligibility Set includes that identity and its resulting count still satisfies Capacity Reserve. A Namespace Generation Integrity Incident changes all exact Failure Domain members atomically through one Namespace Generation Failure Domain Fence Record, and later per-resource exhaustion Receipts cannot create partial visibility. Fewer than two current custodians can neither authorize a Cleanup Fence Exemption nor make this handle returnable. A postclaim/precommit Candidate Secret Version Supersession returns this handle only after exact no-issuance inventory, Cleanup Fence Exemption Evidence, cleanup, Absence Proof and release; it consumes no Candidate Attempt and never rebinds the old Namespace.
_Avoid_: Shared qualification quota, free-space preflight, reusable test namespace

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Qualification Resource Successor Barrier**:
The permanent precondition set for activating a resource-only Recovery Tool Registry successor after `QUARANTINED_EXHAUSTED`, including every claimed resource exhausted across the exact Namespace Generation Failure Domain derived by Namespace Generation Integrity Incident. Every issuance under the old resource must have one dual-route 2-of-3 terminal Issuance Receipt, including `FENCE_CONFLICT`; every committed Issuance Receipt, Credential Mutation Fence or conflict must be dual-route complete and deterministic. Separately, one fully dual-route Namespace Generation Failure Domain Fence Record alone supplies complete resource-fence and exhaustion authority while each derived per-resource exhaustion Receipt remains audit debt; and every Candidate Attempt Chain must be complete and deterministic; every affected old Namespace/account/root/Reservation must be permanently exhausted; and no old mutation credential, cleanup authority or reconciler may remain executable. Satisfying the Barrier does not clear Candidate history or reset the Receipt: when fewer than three distinct identities have closed, only a different identity with checked Candidate Ineligibility Set non-membership, complete Candidate Component Index proof set and a Remediation Claim covering every overlapping barred identity may use a remaining slot, while every conflicted identity stays barred. Barrier evidence includes provider-native live readback of both old and proposed root tenants, mutable parent organizations, root administrators and network control planes at activation; the same projection is re-read in every later Readiness Drill and immediately before the successor's first Qualification Challenge. A timeout or unreadable control plane makes the Standby activation, Drill or first-Challenge check `INCOMPLETE` without exhausting it; provider-confirmed shared mutable parent, root administrator or network control plane permanently makes that proposed or active tuple `QUARANTINED_EXHAUSTED`, fences its Standby and permits no use. Cached configuration or ceremony declarations never substitute. The successor references the unchanged healthy Ledger and opens only a fresh independently controlled root-tenant/account/root/Reservation tuple whose mutable parent organization, root administrator and network control plane are disjoint from the old tuple and every Issuer, candidate, Observer and recovery job. A different cloud provider is allowed only when the existing qualified Bundle, schema, Cleanup Issue Schedule and Exact-Generation Namespace Emptiness Assertion semantic identities remain byte-identical; the same provider still requires the independent root-tenant/admin/network boundary; shared parent administration, migration, dual reconciliation and nonterminal handoff are forbidden. During an incomplete root recovery, only the exact healthy-period-proposed, fully qualified, already matured and freshly exercised Resource Successor Standby with `READY` preincident Resource Successor Coverage is eligible for this Tool Registry activation under `root_recovery_governance`; it changes no Authority, Issuer, Ledger, Bundle, Observer, cleanup schema or other Tool tuple member. Missing derived per-resource exhaustion Receipts after a dual-route durable Namespace Generation Failure Domain Fence Record remain visible audit debt with repeated alerts, but do not block this Barrier, un-fence a member or permit partial domain visibility. Namespace Generation Failure Domain Fence Publication Reconciliation blocks this Barrier until both routes read back the one committed Record; rollback, replacement bytes or one-route completion cannot substitute. Afterward any Namespace Generation Failure Domain Receipt Debt is projected and alerted but never blocks the Barrier. A repaired Fence route satisfies this Barrier only after the assigned Fence Custody Repair Observation and full two-route readback. Receipt debt is represented by one daily aggregate Receipt Debt Alert, never per-member authority.
Candidate Supersession Cleanup Exhaustion enters this Barrier only through Candidate Supersession Cleanup Exhaustion Recovery Sequence as a dual-route no-issuance terminal with one zero-ordinal consumed slot, a permanently exhausted tuple and its required one-entry Candidate Ineligibility Set successor; no Issuance Receipt is synthesized and the Resource Successor cannot activate before those exact facts verify. Activation never resets or replaces the containing Root Recovery Receipt: its consumed distinct-identity count remains exact, the exhausted identity stays globally barred, and only a different eligible identity may use an existing remaining slot.
Namespace Generation Failure Domain Fence Custody Repair Lineage Termination makes this exact Barrier permanently ineligible. Only a fresh locked-root-recovery Receipt, Tool Registry and Namespace Generation lineage may form a different Barrier; no evidence or capacity from the terminated lineage transfers except its immutable incident and Candidate history.
_Avoid_: Live issuance migration, dual resource reconciler, successor before terminal

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Qualification Resource Successor Standby**:
The exact resource-only Recovery Tool Registry successor proposed, fully qualified and placed `PENDING` under ordinary healthy-authority Proofs and Permits, with its 86,400-second wait and first live Resource Successor Standby Drill completed before recovery needs it. It has no fixed TTL, but Resource Successor Coverage is `READY` only while its latest successful Standby Drill is no more than 2,592,000 seconds old; a missed Drill makes coverage `GAP` without blocking otherwise valid ordinary authority, while any identity, parent-isolation, Bundle, schema, Schedule or Assertion semantic change permanently fences it and requires a replacement. In incomplete recovery only this exact matured and freshly exercised Standby may activate after the Resource Successor Barrier; absence, immaturity, stale Drill or changed bytes keeps that recovery blocked, and a different provider is eligible only when the already-qualified Bundle, schema, Cleanup Issue Schedule and Exact-Generation Namespace Emptiness Assertion semantic identities remain byte-identical. Activation consumes its Standby role, immediately derives coverage `GAP`, and requires the newly active healthy Registry to propose and qualify a different `PENDING` Standby; ordinary work may continue during that new 86,400-second maturity and first-Drill interval, but no second resource-only recovery is available. Standby qualification reserves and later uses the same permanent Bootstrap Issuance Ledger as Candidate issuance: it proves checked-`u64` Capacity Reserve before activation and again before each Drill, never compacts or checkpoints prior Drill entries, and never creates a separate Drill Ledger. Every Drill uses a fresh Qualification Subject Identity bound to this Standby Intent and scheduled ordinal; healthy authority rotates to a fully qualified fresh Ledger before capacity shortfall can make the required next Drill impossible. Failure to finish that healthy Ledger rotation before Drill freshness expires changes this Standby's Coverage to `GAP` only; it never authorizes an over-reserve Drill and never blocks otherwise valid ordinary work.
_Avoid_: Incident-time resource proposal, unmatured standby, runtime provider adaptation

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Qualification Resource Successor Standby Drill**:
The permanent dual-route healthy-authority exercise of one exact `PENDING` Resource Successor Standby under one fresh Root Recovery Qualification Subject Identity in the domain-separated `standby_drill` subject, using the real active Bootstrap Issuer and same permanent Issuance Ledger, a real short-lived nonproduction credential, the Standby's own fresh never-reused Qualification Test Namespace and Capacity Reservation, full fixture execution, terminal Receipt ordering, exact cleanup and Qualification Namespace Absence Proof. The at-most-64-KiB strict canonical permanent recovery artifact under domain `turnvector.compatibility-custody-repository-root-recovery-receipt`, published as `compatibility-custody/repository-root-recoveries/<64hex-receipt-id>.json` through the sole root-recovery bootstrap lane only after an out-of-band known-good or new repository trust root has bootstrapped. After Root Recovery Candidate Exhaustion, only a new full out-of-band repository-root ceremony with a fresh trust root may publish one successor Receipt and Descriptor that bind the complete exhausted ancestry; the old Receipt never gains a fourth candidate or extension. The successor Receipt receives at most three semantic Candidate Identities only when Candidate Ineligibility Set Capacity Reserve proves its predecessor Set count is no greater than 65,533. It binds the exact Candidate Ineligibility Set Schema, compound identity/index root, count, ordered identity and Component Index page roots, Custody Object IDs and Publication Receipt Manifest within the 65,536-identity bound, requires a checked canonical Merkle non-membership proof and complete Candidate Component Index proof set for each proposed Candidate, and permanently rejects every set member; every overlapping barred identity must appear in one complete Candidate Remediation Claim. One-good-route byte repair remains eligible, while zero good routes or any root/count/page/provenance disagreement blocks the Receipt without ancestry reconstruction. It may retain the exact unchanged `RECOVERY_LOCKED` Authority and active Recovery Tool Registry only after independent health revalidation and absent any separate replacement trigger; Candidate Exhaustion alone never rotates them. It binds the selected `LOCKED` or `RECOVERY_LOCKED` Root Authority, exact Hardware Profile, Observation Key set and applicable Incident Evidence, Clock Profile Drift, Observer Time-Basis Incident, **Compatibility Custody Repository Root Recovery Artifact Envelope**:
The fixed strict canonical envelope applied separately to Repository Root Recovery Receipt and Repository Recovery Bootstrap Descriptor. Each artifact is at most 64 KiB, uses checked field and byte counts, contains the exact root/Installation/Authority/Lock/Registry/Policy identities and transition selectors required to interpret it, and binds all larger typed evidence only by Repository Root Recovery Evidence Extension Manifest identities and aggregate roots under Repository Root Recovery Evidence Extension Manifest Reference Topology. The two limits are independent and cannot borrow from one another, and the Receipt binds the separately published Descriptor only by exact identity and digest. Unknown fields, untyped blobs, compressed semantic expansion, dynamic size negotiation, inline overflow or omission of a mandatory root invalidates the ceremony.
_Avoid_: Unbounded recovery JSON, shared Receipt/Descriptor limit, dynamically enlarged root artifact

**Compatibility Custody Repository Root Recovery Evidence Extension Manifest**:
The versioned strict canonical segmented representation of bounded recovery evidence referenced from Root Recovery Artifact Envelope. Every page is at most 64 KiB and ordered by typed evidence kind and identity; the manifest carries checked-`u64` evidence/page/logical-byte/per-route-physical-byte counts, exact page identities, route obligations and one domain-separated aggregate root. Repository Root Recovery Evidence Extension Manifest Reference Topology keeps every Manifest one-level and flat, Repository Root Recovery Evidence Extension Manifest Canonical Partition assigns each logical evidence identity to exactly one Manifest, and Repository Root Recovery Artifact Publication Order requires every page and Manifest to publish immutably and fully read back through both recovery routes before the referencing Descriptor or Receipt may commit. The Manifest grants no authority by itself, cannot hide a required envelope selector, and cannot use directory order, duplicate logical references, aggregate-only membership, variable page bounds or external mutable URLs.
_Avoid_: Untyped recovery attachment, aggregate-only extension, mutable evidence URL

**Compatibility Custody Repository Root Recovery Evidence Extension Manifest Capacity Reserve**:
The prospective nonborrowable logical and dual-route physical reservation for both at-most-64-KiB Root Recovery Artifact Envelope objects, every complete Extension Manifest and page, all publication/readback receipts and one mutually exclusive ceremony terminal before any root-recovery artifact or extension page publishes. Insufficient ordinary capacity starts no ceremony and leaves Repository Root Incident Lock unchanged unless the locked lane first completes Repository Root Recovery Evidence Storage Successor; checked-count exhaustion instead follows Repository Root Recovery Evidence Extension Manifest Capacity Exhaustion. Incremental allocation, later page growth, expected compression/deduplication, another governance reserve, omitted evidence or borrowing unused bytes between Receipt and Descriptor is invalid.
_Avoid_: Incremental root evidence reserve, Receipt-to-Descriptor byte loan, compressed recovery capacity

**Compatibility Custody Repository Root Recovery Artifact Publication Order**:
The forward-only root-recovery publication sequence in which every Extension Manifest page is immutable and dual-route readable before its Manifest, every Manifest is immutable and dual-route readable before the separate Bootstrap Descriptor, and the Descriptor is immutable and dual-route readable before the Root Recovery Receipt references its exact identity and digest. Before the first page an exact zero-publication abort may release unused reserve; afterward Repository Root Recovery Artifact Publication Reconciliation permits only the same Ceremony Intent and artifact identities to advance, and any failed terminal creates Repository Root Recovery Artifact Failed Publication Retention Charge. Byte embedding, Receipt-first publication, a Descriptor reconstructed from Receipt fields, unpublished forward references or rollback of an earlier durable object is invalid.
_Avoid_: Embedded recovery descriptor, Receipt-first recovery publication, forward manifest reference

**Compatibility Custody Repository Root Recovery Ceremony Intent**:
The immutable prepublication semantic identity for one complete root-recovery ceremony, domain-separated over the selected ancestor/root/Authority/Lock/Registry state, fixed source generations, complete evidence roots, planned Descriptor projection and Receipt projection while excluding every artifact's self identity and excluding any Descriptor-to-Receipt reference. It is fixed before Publication Order begins and is carried unchanged by every page, Manifest, Descriptor and Receipt; a rebase, cyclic hash input, random retry identity or changed evidence creates a different ceremony rather than resuming this one.
_Avoid_: Receipt-derived ceremony identity, mutable recovery intent, cyclic descriptor hash

**Compatibility Custody Repository Recovery Bootstrap Descriptor Identity**:
The content-addressed identity derived from the domain-separated hash of one complete canonical Bootstrap Descriptor byte string, which carries Repository Root Recovery Ceremony Intent but no Receipt identity, path or self field. Root Recovery Receipt references this identity and the same byte digest in one direction; random IDs, mutual hashes, path identity, Receipt-derived Descriptor bytes or two byte strings under one identity are invalid.
_Avoid_: Random recovery descriptor ID, Receipt-dependent descriptor hash, descriptor path identity

**Compatibility Custody Repository Root Recovery Identity Hash Schema**:
The versioned domain-separated SHA-256 framing shared by Repository Root Recovery Ceremony Intent, Repository Recovery Bootstrap Descriptor Identity and every root-recovery artifact identity, binding an exact domain tag, schema version, canonical byte length and canonical bytes. A hash algorithm or framing change is eligible only through a healthy Tool-Registry schema successor for future identities; old identities are never reinterpreted or migrated in place.
_Avoid_: Unversioned recovery hash, context-free SHA-256, incident-time hash swap

**Compatibility Custody Repository Root Recovery Identity Hash Schema Successor**:
The healthy-authority Tool Registry transition that qualifies a new hash algorithm or framing across every Descriptor, Receipt, recovery Job, reader and canonical fixture before activation. It applies only to identities created by later ceremonies, never rehashes, aliases or reinterprets an existing identity and preserves Repository Root Recovery Identity Hash Schema Historical Reader Custody; after a collision, only a fresh trust-root lineage may activate a separately qualified schema.
_Avoid_: In-place recovery rehash, collision-time algorithm patch, dual-hash identity

**Compatibility Custody Repository Root Recovery Identity Hash Schema Historical Reader Custody**:
The permanent compatibility custody of every activated Identity Hash Schema reader, domain table, canonical codec, golden fixture and exact Tool Bundle needed to verify its historical identities. One digest-valid custody copy permits only byte-identical registered repair, zero valid copies derive Historical Reader Custody Authority Loss, and two distinct digest-valid bundles under one identity derive Repository Root Recovery Identity Hash Schema Historical Reader Custody Copy Conflict; no retention horizon, new schema or algorithm deprecation may reinterpret a reader.
_Avoid_: Retired recovery hash reader, translated historical digest, newest-schema-only verification

**Compatibility Custody Repository Root Recovery Identity Hash Schema Historical Reader Custody Copy Conflict**:
The candidate root cryptographic incident in which one valid observation finds two different canonical historical Reader bundle byte strings verifying under the same bundle identity and Hash Schema. It immediately activates Repository Root Recovery Identity Hash Schema Historical Reader Custody Copy Conflict Provisional Authority Fence, while only Repository Root Recovery Identity Hash Schema Historical Reader Custody Copy Conflict Confirmation derives Identity Hash Collision Incident; route preference, newest generation or majority is invalid.
_Avoid_: Preferred reader route, newest historical bundle, reader-copy majority

**Compatibility Custody Repository Root Recovery Identity Hash Schema Historical Reader Custody Copy Conflict Provisional Authority Fence**:
The immediate schema-wide block created by one valid Copy Conflict observation, covering every historical identity and direct or transitive authority under that Hash Schema before cause confirmation. Neither Reader bundle, route, cached reader, unaffected digest or new work may gain authority while the fence is active; only Repository Root Recovery Identity Hash Schema Historical Reader Custody Copy Conflict Provisional Authority Fence Clearance may reopen future authority, and elapsed time, one later matching route or operator selection cannot clear it.
_Avoid_: Reader-conflict warning, unaffected-digest continuation, route-selected provisional recovery

**Compatibility Custody Repository Root Recovery Identity Hash Schema Historical Reader Custody Copy Conflict Confirmation**:
The fixed-route-generation classification by two independently administered fresh Jobs that each fetch both route generations and independently verify the complete Reader bundle bytes, identities, Hash Schema and collision proof. Byte-identical conflict results derive Identity Hash Collision Incident and the complete Schema Authority Fence, byte-identical no-conflict results permit only Provisional Authority Fence Clearance, byte-identical fixed-route unavailability derives Repository Root Recovery Identity Hash Schema Historical Reader Custody Copy Conflict Confirmation Fixed-Route Generation Unavailable Terminal, and unequal otherwise valid classifications derive Repository Root Recovery Identity Hash Schema Historical Reader Custody Copy Conflict Confirmation Disagreement; one Job, shared implementation, partial bytes, changed route generations, majority or fixture-only reproduction cannot decide it.
_Avoid_: One-job reader collision, shared-verifier conflict proof, fixture-only hash incident

**Compatibility Custody Repository Root Recovery Identity Hash Schema Historical Reader Custody Copy Conflict Confirmation Disagreement**:
The permanent evidence that two otherwise valid independent Confirmation Jobs over the same Reader identity, Hash Schema and fixed custody-route generations disagree whether the originally observed Copy Conflict reproduces. Neither classification, route, majority, later generation or operator choice clears or confirms the incident, and the Provisional Authority Fence remains active until its bounded Disagreement Attempt Chain byte-agrees.
_Avoid_: Reader-confirmation majority, newest-route conflict decision, operator-cleared reader fence

**Compatibility Custody Repository Root Recovery Identity Hash Schema Historical Reader Custody Copy Conflict Confirmation Disagreement Attempt Chain**:
The append-only checked-`u64`, at-most-one-active chain of fresh two-Job confirmations for one exact Reader bundle identity, Hash Schema, original conflict observation and fixed pair of custody-route generations, preserving protected headroom for its checked-`u128` Schema Successor and first new-schema attempt. Each attempt reserves one start plus confirmed-conflict, confirmed-no-conflict, agreed-fixed-route-unavailable, disagreed or incomplete terminal; no other confirmation may run while one is active, and cross-attempt voting, route changes or observation replacement are invalid.
_Avoid_: Parallel reader confirmation, cross-attempt conflict vote, changed-generation confirmation

**Compatibility Custody Repository Root Recovery Identity Hash Schema Historical Reader Custody Copy Conflict Confirmation Fixed-Route Generation Unavailable Terminal**:
The permanent confirmation-lineage terminal when two fresh independent Jobs byte-agree that either fixed custody-route generation required to classify the original Copy Conflict can no longer return its complete digest-valid Reader bundle. The missing classification evidence derives Historical Reader Custody Authority Loss rather than no-conflict, keeps the original observation and every dependent authority fenced and permits no route substitution, newer generation, reconstruction or incomplete retry; any later byte return is only Repository Root Recovery Identity Hash Schema Historical Reader Custody Copy Conflict Confirmation Fixed-Route Generation Unavailable Terminal Late Reappearance Evidence.
_Avoid_: Missing-route no-conflict, replacement-generation confirmation, incomplete reader retry

**Compatibility Custody Repository Root Recovery Identity Hash Schema Historical Reader Custody Copy Conflict Confirmation Fixed-Route Generation Unavailable Terminal Late Reappearance Evidence**:
The typed audit-only observation under Repository Root Recovery Fixed-Generation Late Reappearance Evidence Integrity Lifecycle that complete bytes become readable from the same fixed route generation after its Unavailable Terminal committed. The terminal remains final and the old Confirmation never reopens; a wholly fresh root may import the exact terminal and independently agreed observation when deriving new authority, but the returned bytes grant none by themselves.

Exact read-only reconciliation for a provider call whose network execution already began may use only a still-qualified Credential Boundary Incident Reconciliation Capability outside the Closure and without an Incident Reconciliation Capability Incident; it is evidence collection rather than resumed Runtime authority.
_Avoid_: Seed-only freeze, operator blast-radius exception, cancellation of started calls

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Broker Bootstrap Credential Boundary Operation Dependency Set**:
The canonical sorted transitive set of exact Authority Graph node IDs derived by Current-Tree Authorization Proof from one operation's immutable model, provider, gateway, signing, secret, control-plane and delivery roots under the active propagation matrix. It includes every actually used observation, evidence and read-only node even when its edge type is non-propagating for incident Closure; propagation controls blast-radius expansion, not operation dependency disclosure. The caller, Backend, Runtime cache and operator may supply roots or diagnostics but never the authoritative set; omission, unregistered root, cycle ambiguity or more than 256 resulting nodes makes the operation ineligible.
_Avoid_: Caller dependency list, service allowlist, cached reachability

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Broker Bootstrap Credential Boundary Incident Reconciliation Capability**:
The Tool-Registry-pinned preincident-qualified read-only capability for exact provider invocation or Job IDs whose network execution began before a Credential Boundary incident. It is one explicit Authority Graph observation node with non-propagating read-only edges and is always included in its query's Operation Dependency Set. The original call may return only through its existing deadline, while any subsequent exact-ID query and evidence retrieval ends at the applicable Reconciliation Horizon. The Capability creates no Job, credential, mutation, Open, dispatch or general provider access, and every result is dual-route audit evidence; use for an unstarted or differently identified call is forbidden rather than ordinary Runtime resume. Discovery that safe completion would require mutation creates Credential Boundary Incident Reconciliation Mutation Finding and grants no mutation. Direct inclusion of the node in the incident seed or Closure, confirmed compromise or qualification revocation creates Credential Boundary Incident Reconciliation Capability Incident and disables every query through it.
_Avoid_: Grandfathered provider credential, incident-time query grant, mutating reconciliation

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Broker Bootstrap Credential Boundary Incident Reconciliation Mutation Finding**:
The immutable dual-route evidence that an exact-ID Incident Reconciliation query discovered a provider Job or state whose cancellation, finalization or other safe resolution would require mutation. It records the finding and leaves that effect blocked; the read-only Capability cannot upgrade, mutate or reuse an ordinary credential, and the MVP defines no incident-time mutation capability. Only after complete Credential Boundary Security Recovery may the ordinary current-authority state machine handle that exact Job. Ignoring the Job, automatic cancellation or query-to-mutation escalation is invalid.
_Avoid_: Automatic incident cancellation, read-to-write upgrade, ignored discovered Job

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Broker Bootstrap Credential Boundary Incident Reconciliation Capability Incident**:
The permanent dual-route evidence that the exact preincident Incident Reconciliation Capability node is directly affected, included in the certified Closure, confirmed compromised or qualification-revoked. Every exact-ID reconciliation query through it stops immediately; no standby node, incident-time Tool Registry entry, ordinary provider credential or operator query may replace it. Existing query evidence remains permanent, and only complete Credential Boundary Security Recovery may establish a fresh independently qualified observation node for later incidents.
_Avoid_: Reconciliation failover, ordinary credential query, incident-time observer

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Broker Bootstrap Credential Boundary Runtime Disjointness Proof**:
The fresh Current-Tree Authorization Proof projection required before every post-Closure new Open, dispatch and provider-egress boundary, binding the exact Authority Graph head, certified Closure and the operation's complete dependency set and proving their intersection empty. A process-level cache, TTL, partial dependency list or prior dispatch cannot substitute; any Graph or Closure identity change globally restores Security Freeze until a fresh proof succeeds.
Its canonical Credential Boundary Operation Dependency Set contains at most 256 exact Authority Graph node IDs and the complete proof is at most 64 KiB; an operation whose complete dependency set cannot fit either bound is ineligible rather than paged, approximated, tagged or Bloom-filtered.
_Avoid_: Process startup proof, disjointness TTL, service-name allowlist
