The permanent Installation terminal when the active Candidate Ineligibility Set schema cannot encode every deduplicated Recovery Lineage Carryover identity with complete Component associations and still satisfy the ordinary three-position Capacity Reserve. No identity may be dropped, no fewer-slot Receipt may open and no larger schema may activate inside the locked old Installation. Progress requires a fresh Installation genesis with no Authority or Runtime continuity, Root Recovery Candidate Governance Schema Successor active at that genesis and the complete old Set, all carryover identities, charges and lineage evidence imported without reset.
_Avoid_: Truncated carryover set, reduced Candidate budget, locked-recovery schema growth

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Candidate Identity**:
The stable domain-separated SHA-256 identity of one first-Broker recovery candidate's strict canonical semantic projection, including executable or bundle digest, immutable configuration and schemas, service/account/endpoint identities, signing and JWK sets, gateway and protocol profiles, provider contract and exact Candidate Component Provenance root. A random label, Challenge, namespace, Registry generation or process restart cannot change it; byte-identical semantics remain the same candidate across attempts, while a changed canonical semantic projection creates a different hash rather than resetting the existing Candidate Attempt Chain. After an exhaustion ancestry exists, hash difference alone does not establish eligibility: the candidate must prove non-membership in the bound Candidate Ineligibility Set, both verifiers must recompute the exact overlap union from its complete Candidate Component Index membership/non-membership proof set, and a digest-only rebuild, path, label, timestamp or build-metadata change cannot satisfy the required Candidate Remediation Claim. Once named by Candidate Exhaustion, that exact semantic identity remains ineligible through every successor Receipt in the exhaustion ancestry; a fresh trust root or repackaging cannot rehabilitate it.
_Avoid_: Candidate display name, Challenge ID, service account alone

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Candidate Component Provenance**:
The strict canonical sorted projection of at most the active Candidate Ineligibility Set Schema's component bound - exactly 256 in version one - security- or behavior-bearing non-system executable, library, configuration, model, protocol, gateway, provider and signing components incorporated by one Root Recovery Candidate Identity, with each entry derived by Candidate Component Canonicalization, binding a stable role and execution-relevant content hash, and the projection binding one domain-separated root. Apple system frameworks and libraries and unselected universal-binary slices are excluded only when the exact selected Host Envelope fixes their identity/version or architecture and owns their change invalidation; every other dependency is included regardless of the Candidate's manifest. Both recovery verifiers independently regenerate the projection from isolated Candidate bytes, query every component against the Receipt-bound Candidate Component Index and derive the exact complete set of overlapping barred identities that the Candidate Remediation Claim must cover; an omitted, relabeled, opaque, secret-bearing, whole-Bundle-substituted or component beyond the active bound invalidates the Candidate.
_Avoid_: Declared parent label, package manifest alone, unverified dependency list

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Candidate Component Canonicalization**:
The role-specific projection that hashes exactly the behavior-bearing bytes used under the selected Host Envelope: the selected Mach-O architecture slice with its load commands and referenced code-signature data, each model and tokenizer shard separately, canonical secret-free configuration containing only credential references, and each protocol, gateway/provider and signing implementation as its own component. Unselected universal-binary slices, container padding and secret values do not enter the projection, while a whole-Bundle digest, pathname, mutable label or configuration with embedded secret bytes cannot substitute. For Mach-O the canonical byte stream is the selected slice's header, load commands, every referenced file region and embedded code-signature blob in canonical offset order; other architecture slices, unreferenced alignment padding, filesystem extended attributes and external notarization metadata are excluded. Every model/tokenizer shard remains a separate component, and every credential dependency uses Candidate Secret-Free Configuration Reference; neither shard aggregation nor a mutable secret alias is valid. External notarization, ticket, stapling and extended-attribute state is evaluated only through Candidate Installation Notarization Evidence under Installation Policy and never enters the component hash; the embedded Mach-O signature blob remains identity-bearing.
_Avoid_: Whole-bundle component, secret-value hash, unused architecture slice

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Candidate Secret-Free Configuration Reference**:
The canonical non-secret component binding one credential dependency by provider, account, object, immutable version ID, purpose and exact scope without containing or hashing the credential value. A mutable alias, pathname, environment-variable name, latest-version selector, omitted purpose/scope or secret bytes is not the same reference and invalidates Candidate Component Canonicalization. A provider without a stable immutable version identifier is ineligible. Rotation to another immutable version changes this component and therefore Candidate Identity and requires fresh qualification, even when the secret value is unavailable or coincidentally unchanged; a mutable alias plus live lookup cannot preserve identity. Deletion or permanent unreadability of a qualified immutable version requires Infrastructure Qualification Revocation with reason `secret_version_unavailable`; no alias fallback exists, new Policy/use stops immediately, and only already-started calls finish under their original deadline.
_Avoid_: Secret value hash, mutable secret alias, environment variable name

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Candidate Secret Version Supersession**:
The non-security terminal for an immutable secret-version change during qualification: before Reservation claim it discards only the incomplete preflight; after claim but before `COMMITTED` issuance it closes the old Challenge as `SUPERSEDED`, consumes no Candidate Attempt and requires the exact no-issuance inventory, cleanup, Absence Proof and release path. After `COMMITTED`, the old version remains immutable for reconciliation through its exact terminal and cannot be rebound; any later qualification uses the new Candidate Identity.
Its postclaim/precommit form is one exact dual-route Challenge terminal, never an Issuance Receipt, and binds two-job/two-current-custodian no-commit evidence, immutable inventory and precommitted Cleanup Intent, Absence Proof subject and release identities. Separate completion evidence must later prove cleanup, Absence and release before another Candidate may begin; the terminal permanently consumes the old Candidate Identity's Receipt slot without consuming an Attempt ordinal, and the new secret version creates a different Candidate Identity and another slot.
Permanent completion failure derives Candidate Supersession Cleanup Exhaustion. After successful completion the old identity remains unusable in this Receipt but is not globally barred; a later Receipt may requalify that exact immutable version only when current Policy permits it and the bound Candidate Ineligibility Set proves non-membership.
_Avoid_: Live secret rebind, permanent Candidate invalidation, committed-version mutation

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Candidate Supersession Cleanup Exhaustion**:
The permanent dual-route terminal evidence that cleanup, Qualification Namespace Absence Proof or Reservation release became irrecoverably impossible after one postclaim/precommit `SUPERSEDED` Challenge. It consumes the old Candidate Identity's Receipt slot but no Attempt ordinal, makes the exact namespace/account/root/Reservation `QUARANTINED_EXHAUSTED`, adds that identity and Component Index associations through the next one-entry Candidate Ineligibility Set successor, and blocks every later Candidate until Candidate Supersession Cleanup Exhaustion Recovery Sequence completes through Resource Successor Barrier and a qualified resource successor; `NOT_DELIVERED`, timeout release or retry cannot substitute.
_Avoid_: Superseded retry, nondelivery terminal, released quarantined resource

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Candidate Supersession Cleanup Exhaustion Recovery Sequence**:
The sole ordered recovery path: first dual-route-publish the exact Supersession Cleanup Exhaustion, then use the next authorized ceremony to publish and activate its one-entry Candidate Ineligibility Set successor, satisfy Resource Successor Barrier, activate the exact qualified Resource Successor, and only afterward admit a different eligible Candidate into an existing remaining Receipt slot. Before the first publication, an exact zero-append abort may start a fresh Sequence Intent. Once any step publishes, the Sequence permanently binds that Intent, predecessor, Set successor, Barrier, Resource Successor and containing Receipt; a crash resumes only the same bytes at the first incomplete step and cannot restart, skip or substitute any identity. Confirmed compromise, revocation or permanent disqualification of any bound Set successor, Barrier authority or Resource Successor after that point derives Candidate Supersession Recovery Lineage Termination. No step runs in parallel or out of order, the old identity remains barred, and neither the Receipt identity nor its consumed-slot count resets.
_Avoid_: Parallel supersession recovery, pre-Barrier candidate, reset Receipt budget

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Candidate Supersession Recovery Lineage Termination**:
The permanent terminal state of one post-publication Candidate Supersession Cleanup Exhaustion Recovery Sequence after any exact bound Set successor, Barrier authority or Resource Successor becomes compromised, revoked or permanently disqualified. Its commit first applies Root Recovery Candidate Recovery Lineage Authority Fence to every dependent Profile and Success Receipt. Every completed step and consumed Candidate/Receipt fact remains permanent; waiting, requalification, replacement identity or resuming another step is forbidden. Before progress, Root Recovery Candidate Recovery Lineage Carryover must atomically add every consumed identity dependent on this terminated sequence to the successor Ineligibility Set. Only then may a fresh out-of-band Root Recovery Receipt and lineage import the old Set and incident evidence without importing remaining slots or unfinished sequence authority.
_Avoid_: Mid-sequence resource substitution, recovered old sequence, remaining-slot transfer

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Candidate Installation Notarization Evidence**:
The non-identity Installation-Policy observation that the exact Candidate component hashes and embedded signing identity satisfy the policy's current external notarization or platform-trust requirement at verification time. It binds Installation Policy Identity, Candidate Identity, verifier result and trusted time; external ticket, stapling and extended-attribute bytes never enter Candidate Component Canonicalization, while missing or failed evidence blocks qualification whenever the Policy requires it. It is eligible only when observed no more than 300 seconds before Candidate qualification and is independently refreshed no more than 300 seconds before credential delivery and final Policy activation. Verifier unavailability is `INCOMPLETE`; later notarization or signing-identity revocation requires Infrastructure Qualification Revocation of the exact Secret Broker Profile and blocks not-yet-started use.
Two available, otherwise valid verifier jobs that return different trust results for the same Candidate, Policy Identity and observation window derive Candidate Installation Trust Disagreement rather than `INCOMPLETE` or a majority result. One valid `INVALID` result paired with verifier unavailability instead derives Candidate Installation Trust Unresolved.
_Avoid_: Candidate component hash, ignored policy gate, stapling-derived identity

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Candidate Installation Trust Disagreement**:
The permanent dual-route evidence that two independently qualified and otherwise valid verifier jobs returned contradictory notarization or platform-trust results for the same Candidate Identity, Installation Policy Identity and bounded observation window. It blocks that qualification without majority or operator choice; if the disagreement concerns an already active Secret Broker Profile, exact Infrastructure Qualification Revocation with reason `candidate_installation_trust_disagreement` is mandatory. The same Candidate Identity may later requalify only under a fresh Profile lineage with new two-verifier agreement; a disagreement before Reservation claim consumes no Candidate slot or Attempt, while its evidence remains permanent.
_Avoid_: Notarization majority, verifier timeout, operator trust choice

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Candidate Installation Trust Unresolved**:
The fail-closed nonterminal state created at Candidate qualification, credential delivery or final Policy activation when one otherwise valid verifier returns `INVALID` for the exact Candidate and Installation Policy while the other verifier is unavailable or incomplete. It immediately blocks the next boundary and an already active affected Secret Broker Profile blocks new authority, but it never synthesizes an issuance terminal or permanent Infrastructure Qualification Revocation; elapsed time never upgrades it or restores use. Before Reservation claim, a fully fresh Profile lineage may re-evaluate the same immutable Candidate only by binding this predecessor evidence and obtaining two fresh valid verifier results, with no old result, Candidate slot or Attempt carried forward. At or after claim, the occupied Candidate slot remains consumed; any existing `COMMITTED` issuance reconciles only to its provider-evidence-derived terminal, and the same Candidate may proceed no further until a fresh Profile produces two fresh valid results. Later contradictory valid results become Candidate Installation Trust Disagreement.
_Avoid_: One-verifier revocation, unavailable-is-valid, continued Profile use

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Candidate Component Index**:
The content-addressed canonical secondary Merkle mapping from each Candidate Component Provenance role-and-content hash to the ascending complete set of barred Candidate Identities that bind it, rebuilt and independently verified from every identity entry whenever a Candidate Ineligibility Set successor is published. It uses the Set Schema's fixed page/hash rules, has at most 16,777,216 associations, and its root joins the identity-tree root in the Receipt-bound compound root. For each proposed component, both verifiers require the canonical membership proof and complete candidate list or the canonical non-membership proof; the union of all returned identities is the exact remediation set, so an external database, full Set scan, partial index or omitted association grants no eligibility. One corrupt or missing Index page is Artifact-Repair-eligible only byte-for-byte from the other fully verified custody route followed by complete compound-root recomputation; with zero good copies it cannot be rebuilt from the identity tree even though the mapping is deterministic.
_Avoid_: External component database, best-effort overlap scan, candidate-declared parent index

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Candidate Remediation Claim**:
The strict canonical comparison required when a proposed Candidate's verifier-recomputed Component Provenance reuses any component hash bound by an identity in the Candidate Ineligibility Set. It binds the new projection, the exact sorted complete set of every overlapping barred Candidate Identity and provenance root, each prior semantic projection and failure evidence, and for every such identity at least one changed security or behavioral field that addresses its evidence. Both recovery verifiers must independently verify the complete Candidate Component Index proof set, derive the same overlap set and reproduce every comparison; an omitted parent, path, label, timestamp, build metadata, digest-only rebuild or byte-identical repackaging never establishes eligibility.
_Avoid_: New build number, renamed bundle, unexplained digest change

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Candidate Ineligibility Set Schema**:
The Recovery-Tool-Registry-pinned canonical schema for Candidate Ineligibility Set version one: ascending raw 32-byte Candidate Identity order, domain-separated SHA-256, at most 256 identity-and-Component-Provenance-root entries per immutable identity page, a canonical Merkle tree over ordered identity-page hashes, one Candidate Component Index with at most 16,777,216 component-to-candidate associations, and one compound root committing both trees, with a hard maximum of 65,536 distinct identities. Identity non-membership proves the canonical adjacent entries or boundary in one page plus that page's top-tree path, while component eligibility uses the complete Candidate Component Index membership/non-membership proof set. A larger bound, page shape, hash domain or encoding requires one Candidate Ineligibility Set Schema Successor under an ordinary healthy-authority Tool Registry successor before an incident; exact identity-set equality, full Component Index recomputation, dual-route publication/readback and atomic activation are mandatory, with no dual-read or rollback; locked recovery cannot upgrade it, and Candidate Ineligibility Set Capacity Reserve prevents a new three-candidate Receipt once fewer than three identity positions remain. Version one also fixes Candidate Component Provenance at 256 entries, so a Candidate with a 257th model shard or other component is ineligible rather than aggregated. Only a healthy-authority Candidate Ineligibility Set Schema Successor may raise that bound while preserving each shard as a separate component.
_Avoid_: Unbounded Merkle set, database lookup, incident-time schema expansion

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Candidate Ineligibility Set Schema Successor**:
The one-way healthy-authority-only replacement of one Candidate Ineligibility Set Schema by a fully qualified successor. Two independent jobs re-encode every predecessor identity, prove exact set equality, recompute every Candidate Component Index association and both compound-root trees, publish and fully read back all pages through both custody routes, and atomically activate the new schema only with its Tool Registry successor; old bytes remain permanent evidence, and no dual-read interval, rollback, in-place rewrite, incident-time transform or concurrent Candidate addition is permitted. A crash before the activation CAS resumes only the exact same pending successor identity and verifies every already published byte again. Healthy cancellation leaves those immutable bytes as inert permanent custody evidence that no current reader may consult; a later Intent must use a fresh successor identity and republish a fresh logical manifest and route receipts even for byte-identical content, and neither orphan deletion, automatic activation nor dual-read recovery is permitted. A component-bound increase preserves every shard as its own canonical entry and never substitutes an aggregate digest. Physical content-addressed page objects may be deduplicated by identical hash only after both routes verify them, but every fresh successor Intent publishes a new immutable logical manifest and new route receipts. A canceled Intent's manifest or receipts never cross to another Intent or become activation authority. Every active or canceled Intent creates a Schema Successor Retention Charge over its logical manifest, route receipts and all referenced page hashes; physical dedup never releases a page while any permanent manifest references it.
_Avoid_: In-place Set migration, dual-schema recovery, rollback to old root

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Candidate Ineligibility Set Schema Successor Retention Charge**:
The no-TTL logical custody charge for every immutable active or canceled Schema Successor manifest and both route receipts, binding every referenced content-addressed page hash even when physical bytes are deduplicated with another Intent. A page remains retained while any permanent manifest references it; cancellation, refcount observation, identical content, successor activation or storage pressure cannot release or transfer the charge.
The charge is admitted only through a satisfied Schema Successor Retention Capacity Reserve created before any manifest or page publication and becomes permanent exactly at Schema Successor Retention Charge Commit Boundary. In this definition a canceled Intent is chargeable only after crossing that Boundary; an exact zero-publication abort has created no published Schema Successor Intent and releases its reservation.
_Avoid_: Canceled-manifest garbage collection, physical-copy charge, refcount authority

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Candidate Ineligibility Set Schema Successor Retention Charge Commit Boundary**:
The first successful external publication of the successor's immutable logical manifest, either route receipt or any new reference from that manifest to a content-addressed page. Before that boundary an exact zero-publication abort releases the whole reservation; at and after it the complete reserved logical charge is permanent, and crash, partial route publication, corruption or cancellation may only resume, Artifact Repair from one exact good copy or terminally preserve the same Intent rather than release capacity. Zero good copies permanently consume the charge and block that successor without reconstruction.
_Avoid_: Dual-route commit point, proposal-time permanent charge, partial-publication refund

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Candidate Ineligibility Set Schema Successor Retention Capacity Reserve**:
The prepublication fail-closed reservation of worst-case logical custody for one Schema Successor's immutable manifest, both route receipts and every referenced page under its permanent Retention Charge. Insufficient logical capacity derives Schema Successor Retention Capacity Exhaustion and blocks proposal before any bytes publish; physical deduplication, expected cancellation, refcount decrease, later activation or reclaimable storage cannot reduce the reservation.
_Avoid_: Physical-byte reserve, postpublication capacity check, canceled-intent credit

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Candidate Ineligibility Set Schema Successor Retention Capacity Exhaustion**:
The capacity condition that blocks every new Candidate Ineligibility Set Schema Successor proposal when its worst-case logical Retention Capacity Reserve cannot be satisfied. It does not block the active schema, existing Runtime or unrelated ordinary governance, and capacity may increase only through Compatibility Custody Retention Storage Successor funded by Compatibility Custody Retention Governance Reserve; canceled-artifact deletion, physical dedup credit, incident-time storage or ordinary garbage collection cannot clear it.
_Avoid_: Runtime storage emergency, canceled-page garbage collection, incident-time capacity

**Compatibility Custody Retention Governance Reserve**:
The installation-wide healthy-period reservation, physically and logically independent from every Candidate Set or Graph Schema retention pool, sized for the complete worst-case Compatibility Custody Retention Storage Successor proposal, qualification, publication and activation workflow. Only one serialized exact Storage Successor may claim it; when Set and Graph pools both need capacity, that proposal binds both pool states and expands their separately accounted capacity atomically. Ordinary artifacts, Schema successors and Runtime work cannot borrow it, and exhaustion of a target retention pool never expands, releases or substitutes this reserve. Inability to fund the complete workflow derives Compatibility Custody Retention Governance Exhaustion rather than a second-tier reserve.
_Avoid_: Borrowed Set capacity, cleanup-funded expansion, incident-time storage reserve

**Compatibility Custody Retention Storage Successor**:
The single serialized custody-storage replacement funded by Retention Governance Reserve, binding one exact Retention Storage Successor Snapshot and admitted either through Retention Storage Expansion Eligibility during ordinary healthy growth or through Retention Governance Installation Replacement Physical Capacity Reservation Loss Recovery after confirmed post-Genesis Reservation Loss. If both eligible pool classes require expansion, or Loss Recovery requires replacement of either physical reservation, one proposal covers both routes and all affected pools and atomically activates their independently accounted new capacities; first-come priority, concurrent successors, partial activation and charge merging are invalid. Exact zero-publication abort may release its claim. After its first external publication only the same identity may resume forward; one fully verified custody copy permits byte-for-byte Artifact Repair and exact-identity resume, while zero good copies or another terminal committed failure derives Retention Governance Exhaustion.
_Avoid_: Per-schema storage race, merged logical charge, incident-time disk expansion

**Compatibility Custody Retention Storage Successor Snapshot**:
The immutable healthy-authority snapshot of every Candidate Set and Graph Schema pool's exact active schema, logical capacity, permanent charges, reservations, pending proposal identities and exhaustion predicates used by one Storage Successor. It may be captured and used to claim Retention Governance Reserve only after Retention Storage Successor Charge Drain Proof has stopped new charge-capable admission and proved every previously admitted retention-charge-creating workflow terminal or exactly canceled without future commit authority. Once the successor claims against it, every new schema proposal and retention-charge-creating operation remains blocked until exact zero-publication abort, activation or terminal failure; existing valid Runtime, active-schema reads and evidence readback continue. Rebase, partial-pool refresh, a late predecessor commit or a concurrent charge invalidates rather than updates the Snapshot.
_Avoid_: Rebased storage capacity, per-pool snapshot time, Runtime pause

**Compatibility Custody Retention Storage Successor Charge Drain Proof**:
The system-derived current-tree proof that, after Retention Storage Successor Charge Admission Fence atomically stops new Candidate Set and Graph Schema retention-charge admission, every exact pending proposal, reservation and charge-capable workflow admitted under an earlier generation has reached a permanent terminal or an exact pre-commit cancellation that can no longer publish or charge. It binds the Fence generation, complete pre-Fence workflow set and each terminal, has no elapsed-time shortcut, and is consumed only by the matching Retention Storage Successor Snapshot and Reserve claim. A worst-case allowance for a still-live writer, late commit, partial-pool drain, scheduler emptiness or Snapshot rebase is invalid.
_Avoid_: In-flight retention writer, snapshot reserve guess, timeout drain

**Compatibility Custody Retention Storage Successor Charge Admission Fence**:
The checked-generation current-tree authority transition that atomically closes admission of every new Candidate Set or Graph Schema workflow capable of creating a retention charge across all target pools. Each admitted workflow binds the exact open generation at start and must present it again at its final publication/charge CAS; only an identity already present in the Fence's pre-Fence workflow set may finish under that generation, while a workflow first started after the Fence or lacking the generation is rejected even if a scheduler or process observed stale admission state. Pre-Fence workflows remain visible and must reach their own terminal before Charge Drain Proof; Retention Storage Successor Charge Admission Fence Release Boundary alone may open another generation. Process pause, wall-clock snapshot, local mutex or best-effort queue drain cannot substitute.
_Avoid_: Scheduler-only charge stop, timestamp admission fence, unbound late writer

**Compatibility Custody Retention Storage Successor Charge Admission Fence Release Boundary**:
The atomic next-generation transition after one Charge Admission Fence and complete Charge Drain Proof, executed and recovered only through Retention Storage Successor Charge Admission Fence Release Reconciliation. Exact zero-publication Storage Successor abort may open a fresh generation over the unchanged pools only after revalidating every pre-Fence workflow terminal; successful Storage Successor activation opens a fresh generation over the new independently accounted pools. A terminal Storage Successor failure or Retention Governance Exhaustion leaves admission closed. Reusing the fenced generation, reopening before drain, timer release, partial-pool opening or allowing an unlisted old-generation writer is invalid.
_Avoid_: Automatic charge-fence reopen, reused admission generation, partial-pool release

**Compatibility Custody Retention Storage Successor Charge Admission Fence Release Reconciliation**:
The deterministic transition-ID and exact-generation CAS protocol for one Charge Admission Fence Release Boundary. The ID binds the closed Fence generation, complete Drain Proof, zero-publication abort or successful Storage Successor result, exact target pools and proposed fresh open generation. After crash or uncertain acknowledgement, current-tree readback alone decides: the exact matching successor means committed and open, the unchanged exact predecessor means uncommitted and closed and may retry only the same ID, while any third, duplicate, partially open or mismatched state derives Retention Storage Successor Charge Admission Fence Release Integrity Incident. A new ID, timeout, local success flag or inferred partial release cannot decide.
_Avoid_: Alternate release ID, timeout fence opening, local-CAS acknowledgement

**Compatibility Custody Retention Storage Successor Charge Admission Fence Release Integrity Incident**:
The permanent current-tree integrity evidence produced by any third state during Charge Admission Fence Release Reconciliation, including two open generations, a partial-pool release, mismatched transition ID or a successor not bound to the exact Fence and Drain Proof. It immediately keeps all charge admission closed and derives Repository Root Integrity Incident before any retention, governance, Policy or Runtime authority boundary may trust the tree. Neither generation may be preferred, merged, deleted or repaired by another Release transition.
_Avoid_: Preferred open generation, partial fence repair, second release transition

**Compatibility Custody Retention Storage Expansion Eligibility**:
The deterministic predicate satisfied only for a retention pool whose next complete worst-case Schema Successor reservation cannot fit its current uncharged logical capacity. A Storage Successor expands exactly the eligible pool set captured in its Snapshot; when both Set and Graph pools qualify they share one workflow, while a merely convenient or operator-selected noneligible pool cannot receive speculative capacity.
_Avoid_: Proactive all-pool expansion, operator capacity target, average-size reserve

**Compatibility Custody Retention Governance Exhaustion**:
The installation-wide terminal governance predicate produced when Retention Governance Reserve cannot fund a complete Storage Successor or a committed Storage Successor cannot finish with verifiable custody. It blocks every new Schema, retention-pool and custody-storage growth operation while existing valid Runtime, active-schema reads and evidence readback may continue. There is no reserve-of-reserve, ordinary-capacity loan, cleanup credit or in-place recovery; only Compatibility Custody Retention Governance Installation Replacement may establish new retention governance.
_Avoid_: Reserve recursion, borrowed Runtime storage, automatic installation shutdown

**Compatibility Custody Retention Governance Installation Replacement**:
The out-of-band fresh Installation genesis after Retention Governance Exhaustion or another Installation Replacement Incident Set member, coalescing every simultaneously current installation-terminal cause rather than creating sequential or competing replacement Installations. Installation Replacement Candidate Attempt Chain and Candidate Attempt Capacity Reserve serialize each immutable candidate. Evidence Universe Derivation Proof, Evidence Universe Derivation Disagreement Attempt Chain and Evidence Universe Reader Capability Block, plus Evidence Universe Manifest Schema and Evidence Universe Manifest Capacity Reserve produce the segmented Evidence Universe Manifest and Import Gap Manifest. Only byte-verified immutable evidence and each artifact's exact permanent logical charge enter newly established independent custody whose logical and physical capacity is admitted by Installation Replacement Capacity Proof, a qualified Physical Capacity Reservation Primitive on each route and Installation Replacement Physical Capacity Reserve with an independent Retention Governance Reserve; Physical Capacity Reservation Loss follows its phase-specific terminal. Installation Replacement Genesis Commit Boundary selects the sole successor, and Installation Replacement Publication Boundary controls abort versus same-identity resume and Failed Candidate Retention Charge. Nonce History Capacity Exhaustion requires Graph Repair Nonce History Schema Successor active at genesis, Entropy Platform Incident requires Graph Repair Entropy Platform Isolation Proof, and Audit Authority Chain Loss starts the new audit lineage only through Committed Credential Containment Audit Chain Genesis and its Cursor Boundary. Missing old evidence remains explicitly unavailable and is never reconstructed; the exhausted Installation stays read-only, and no Runtime, Policy, authority, capacity counter or in-flight operation continues into the replacement. Copying numeric capacity, dropping charges, treating location equality as authority or activating more than one successor genesis is invalid.
_Avoid_: In-place retention reset, Runtime-preserving storage migration, discarded logical charge

**Compatibility Custody Retention Governance Installation Replacement Import Gap Manifest**:
The strict immutable classification of every member of Retention Governance Installation Replacement Evidence Universe and permanent logical charge as fully byte-verified and imported, fully verified and intentionally retained only in the read-only predecessor, or unavailable with exact route/job/custodian observations. An unavailable or incompletely verified object may be retained only as explicitly untrusted historical material and cannot support an imported authority, continuity, completion, absence or capacity claim. The fresh Installation may establish wholly new authority despite such gaps, but it cannot silently omit, summarize, reconstruct or promote them. Evidence recovered after genesis follows Installation Replacement Late Evidence Import and never edits this Manifest.
_Avoid_: Silent evidence omission, receipt reconstruction, unverified imported claim

**Compatibility Custody Retention Governance Installation Replacement Evidence Universe**:
The canonical complete deduplicated object-and-charge closure at the predecessor Installation's fixed terminal head, established by Retention Governance Installation Replacement Evidence Universe Derivation Proof and encoded by Retention Governance Installation Replacement Evidence Universe Manifest. Its last fully verified periodic Artifact Inventory is only an input seed; every complete Root Authority, Tool Registry, Receipt, audit, retention-charge and unresolved-operation chain reachable from the fixed head is rederived. Directory listing, Git history traversal alone, operator inventory, a partial chain or omission of an unavailable expected member is invalid.
_Avoid_: Storage listing import universe, operator-selected evidence, missing-object omission

**Compatibility Custody Retention Governance Installation Replacement Evidence Universe Derivation Proof**:
The byte-identical result from two fresh independent import jobs that each perform a complete Inventory-style derivation at the exact predecessor terminal head, replaying every authoritative registry and chain reader to produce the ordered expected object identities, route obligations, provenance and permanent logical charges. A prior weekly Inventory may seed fetching but cannot establish freshness or membership. Otherwise valid job disagreement derives Evidence Universe Derivation Disagreement; an unknown reader or schema follows Evidence Universe Reader Capability Block. Missing chain closure, head movement or an object known only through a listing blocks Genesis rather than selecting one universe. Every Manifest count, range, entry and aggregate root must be derived exactly from these bytes; any mismatch follows Evidence Universe Manifest Integrity Incident rather than recalculation.
_Avoid_: Stale inventory authority, incremental-only import scan, one-job universe

**Compatibility Custody Retention Governance Installation Replacement Evidence Universe Derivation Disagreement**:
The permanent candidate evidence when two fresh import Jobs return different otherwise valid Evidence Universe object membership, route obligation, provenance, charge, count or root for the same predecessor terminal head and reader set. Neither result, their union, intersection, majority or later timestamp establishes the Universe. The candidate remains unable to publish a Manifest or Genesis and every later attempt is serialized through Evidence Universe Derivation Disagreement Attempt Chain.
_Avoid_: Union import universe, preferred derivation job, disagreement majority

**Compatibility Custody Retention Governance Installation Replacement Evidence Universe Derivation Disagreement Attempt Chain**:
The append-only checked-`u64`, at-most-one-active chain of fresh two-job derivation attempts for one candidate after Evidence Universe Derivation Disagreement. Before each attempt it prospectively reserves custody and sequence capacity for the attempt plus one mutually exclusive agreed, disagreed or incomplete terminal, and fixes the predecessor head, reader set and both fresh Job identities. Every result remains permanent; no elapsed-time or attempt-count escalation, mixed result or late-result adoption is valid. An agreed byte-identical result may produce Derivation Proof, while inability to reserve the complete next entry derives Evidence Universe Derivation Disagreement Attempt Chain Capacity Exhaustion.
_Avoid_: Parallel universe derivation, unrecorded derivation retry, timeout-selected universe

**Compatibility Custody Retention Governance Installation Replacement Evidence Universe Derivation Disagreement Attempt Chain Capacity Exhaustion**:
The permanent failed-candidate terminal when an Evidence Universe Derivation Disagreement Attempt Chain cannot reserve one complete next attempt and terminal. It selects no Universe, preserves every observation and prevents Genesis under that candidate. Because disagreement evidence has crossed Installation Replacement Publication Boundary, the candidate closes through Failed Candidate Retention Charge and a later candidate must import the chain and terminal without reset.
_Avoid_: Derivation-chain wrap, capacity-selected universe, same-candidate larger counter

**Compatibility Custody Retention Governance Installation Replacement Evidence Universe Reader Capability Block**:
The phase-aware block when a required authoritative chain member uses an unknown, unsupported or unqualified reader/schema during Evidence Universe derivation. **Compatibility Custody Qualification Test Namespace**:
The isolated nonproduction service account and namespace created fresh for exactly one infrastructure qualification generation, one Root Recovery Readiness Drill or one typed Resource Successor Standby Drill and never reused by any earlier or later Challenge, Candidate or Drill. It binds a fixed fixture identity, generation and finite object-path manifest. For first post-root-recovery Broker qualification it additionally binds the exact Root Recovery Candidate Identity and Component Provenance, Candidate Component Index proof set, Candidate Ineligibility Set Schema/Set/Capacity Reserve eligibility, Candidate Attempt Chain ordinal and Candidate slot; for a `standby_drill` it instead binds the exact pending Standby and proves those Candidate fields absent. Both subject kinds bind their Qualification Capacity Reservation claim, Bootstrap Issuer profile, four-terminal Issuance Ledger, issuance ID when committed, precommitted Fence ID, Bootstrap Issuance Receipts, any Fence Conflict, and any no-issuance `RANDOMNESS_ABORTED` terminal. It has no production route, object, tenant or credential authority, and every created object is confined to that manifest and uses conditional create, generation-matched cleanup at the shared Cleanup Issue Schedule and the complete Qualification Namespace Absence Proof; a prequalified provider-native read-only exact-generation emptiness assertion complements rather than replaces every per-path readback, without list or wildcard authority; an absent finite manifest plus nonempty native assertion enters Namespace Emptiness Mismatch and never proves cleanup. Creation is atomic with Reservation claim; every later incomplete attempt must complete its exact inventory, cleanup and terminal path, and if a bootstrap credential may have been delivered, inventory and cleanup wait for the sole precommitted-ID Credential Mutation Fence fully published and read back through both recovery routes; a dual-route `NOT_DELIVERED` terminal instead requires branch-appropriate live 2-of-3 exact-terminal Ledger proof, while a pre-issuance Drill/preclaim or `RANDOMNESS_ABORTED` failure requires live 2-of-3 complete-history proof of no matching `COMMITTED`; both paths require byte-identical two-job evidence, two current custodians' byte-identical Root Hardware Credential assertions and exact Cleanup Fence Exemption Evidence before cleanup. If that live Ledger proof is unavailable, no Exemption or cleanup occurs and a full root ceremony may only abandon the tuple permanently. A Fence Conflict or Namespace Generation Integrity Incident permanently exhausts the account/root/Namespace/Reservation and authorizes no cleanup or release; the latter fences every active or pending tuple in its exact Namespace Generation Failure Domain. Candidate delivery or execution in an affected tuple permanently invalidates that Candidate and Attempt Chain, while a pure Readiness or Standby Drill has no Candidate effect; only the exact Resource Successor Barrier and independently qualified preincident Standby lane may continue. Other cleanup failure permanently invalidates that candidate or Drill, immediately quarantines the namespace and its Reservation claim from reuse, and preserves its complete authentication-free inventory and cleanup evidence in dual custody for 31,536,000 seconds. Only the exact Root Recovery Qualification Cleanup Capability may repair the original observed generations and produce the complete Absence Proof; successful later cleanup normally may return the standing Reservation to `AVAILABLE`, but delivery uncertainty keeps it quarantined through credential expiry and dual-route publication/readback of the `DELIVERY_UNKNOWN_EXPIRED` terminal Receipt; cleanup never revives, activates or rewrites the failed candidate, Drill or namespace, and a new qualification or Drill always creates a new namespace and generation. Every Namespace binds the fresh Qualification Subject Identity and prospective Bootstrap Issuance Ledger Capacity Reserve decision for its typed Candidate or Standby-Drill subject. Permanent post-`RANDOMNESS_ABORTED` inventory, cleanup, Absence-Proof or release failure derives Candidate Randomness Cleanup Exhaustion with no ordinal carry; any out-of-scope old credential event derives the separate Broker Bootstrap Credential Scope Escape Incident and blocks ordinary successor Policy. Namespace Generation Integrity Incident affects members only through its atomic Namespace Generation Failure Domain Fence Record and incident index, and fewer than two current custodians can never authorize cleanup. Candidate Secret Version Supersession after claim requires the same fixed inventory, no-issuance proof, cleanup and Absence Proof before release; the Namespace never crosses to the new Candidate Identity.
_Avoid_: Production canary, shared test bucket, best-effort cleanup

**Compatibility Custody Exact-Generation Namespace Emptiness Assertion**:
The provider-native read-only assertion linearizable with the qualification namespace's generation-matched conditional deletes, returning one exact namespace generation token and empty/nonempty result under the active qualified schema. Both independent recovery jobs must obtain the same token and empty result for release. A token may change across Cleanup Issue ordinals only when the predecessor contains a successful state-changing authorized conditional-delete Receipt proving removal of its bound generation and an exact old-token/delete/new-token transition; unequal tokens in one issue or token drift after a read-only issue derives Namespace Generation Integrity Incident and derives the exact Namespace Generation Failure Domain and permanently fences every active or pending tuple inside it. Eventual observation, list output, sampled paths or administrator testimony is ineligible rather than becoming evidence after retries.
_Avoid_: Eventually empty status, namespace listing, mismatched generation tokens

**Compatibility Custody Qualification Namespace Absence Proof**:
The permanent dual-route evidence that one exact Qualification Test Namespace generation is empty, requiring both complete per-path absence or generation readbacks over the fixture-precommitted finite object-path manifest and one Exact-Generation Namespace Emptiness Assertion linearizable with generation-matched conditional deletes and returning the same empty generation token to both independent jobs. Provider qualification and Tool Registry activation reject any profile that lacks this semantic identity or provides only eventual observation; a list result, administrator assertion or planned quarantine is never an alternate proof. The primitive cannot enumerate names, list another namespace, wildcard, mutate or infer absence from missing credential delivery; both independently qualified evidence jobs, specifically the two recovery jobs for a root-recovery claim, must agree on the manifest, every path result, the identical namespace generation token, any successful state-changing authorized predecessor-delete token transition, empty result and trusted observation time before cleanup or Reservation release is complete. When every finite-manifest path is absent but the native exact-generation assertion remains nonempty, no Absence Proof exists: the attempt enters Namespace Emptiness Mismatch and may only consume the existing at-most-eight Cleanup Issue Chain's read-only retries.
_Avoid_: Namespace listing, no-credential inference, sampled object check

**Compatibility Custody Qualification Namespace Emptiness Mismatch**:
The bounded cleanup state in which every fixture-manifest path reads absent but the Exact-Generation Namespace Emptiness Assertion returns nonempty at one token agreed by both independent jobs. It consumes successive read-only ordinals at the shared Cleanup Issue Schedule's minimum ages in the existing at-most-eight Cleanup Issue Chain without list, wildcard or unknown-object delete authority; a later agreed known manifest generation follows ordinary exact conditional cleanup, while an eighth still-mismatched assertion permanently makes the Namespace and Reservation `QUARANTINED_EXHAUSTED`. Unequal same-issue tokens or uncaused token drift are not this bounded state and instead derive Namespace Generation Integrity Incident immediately.
_Avoid_: Namespace list fallback, immediate inferred absence, unknown-object delete

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Qualification Namespace Generation Failure Domain**:
The exact finite sorted set at one Authority-certified Registry head of every active or pending Recovery Tool Registry tuple sharing all three identities implicated by one Namespace Generation Integrity Incident: provider, Exact-Generation Namespace Emptiness Assertion implementation and provider control-plane generation. Registry history, not provider brand or runtime discovery, derives the set; every member is fenced and each claimed resource is exhausted, while a tuple with a different independently qualified identity in any of the three positions remains outside the Incident. The set enters one Namespace Generation Failure Domain Fence Record and is permanent dual-route evidence and never expands by similarity, account ownership assumption or provider-wide inference. The certified Registry admits at most 256 active or pending members for any one triple and, before every activation, proves a complete at-most-64-KiB Fence Record for the prospective set can be reserved and encoded. A 257th member or insufficient record capacity is rejected before activation rather than chunked, approximated or left unfenceable. Any tuple changing one of the three identities uses exactly one Failure Domain Membership Transfer; until its Registry CAS commits it remains a member of the old triple, and both old and new incident indexes and the new 256-member/record reserve are checked atomically.
_Avoid_: Current namespace only, whole-provider ban, runtime guessed blast radius

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Qualification Namespace Generation Failure Domain Membership Transfer**:
The one Registry compare-and-swap that moves one active or pending tuple from an old failure-domain triple to a different independently qualified triple, atomically reserving the new triple's member and Fence-Record capacity, removing current membership from the old triple and rechecking both incident indexes against the same predecessor head. The tuple remains counted in the old triple until commit; a failed check changes neither set, and remove-then-add, temporary no-domain membership or two-commit overlap is invalid.
_Avoid_: Remove then add, dual-domain transition window, unchecked triple edit

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Qualification Namespace Generation Failure Domain Fence Record**:
The single immutable Authority-committed record for one Namespace Generation Integrity Incident, binding the exact Registry head, Assertion token evidence, complete sorted Namespace Generation Failure Domain member set and the exact preincident Fence Custody Repair Witness active at this commit. One linearizable commit atomically fences every active or pending member and indexes the affected provider/Assertion-implementation/control-plane-generation triple before any concurrent activation can pass; later per-resource exhaustion Receipts are derived evidence and never create partial fence visibility. Every activation rechecks the incident index against its own triple, while asynchronous discovery, per-tuple commits or a provider-wide approximation are invalid. The canonical record is at most 64 KiB and contains at most 256 members, with capacity reserved before each member activation. Authority fencing begins at its one linearizable commit; after the exact bytes publish and read back through both custody routes, the Record alone satisfies Resource Successor Barrier fence/exhaustion evidence. Every per-resource exhaustion Receipt must still be deterministically backfilled under repeated audit alerting, but its absence never delays the Barrier, narrows the fence or creates visibility. Partial custody publication enters Namespace Generation Failure Domain Fence Publication Reconciliation: the committed fence is already irreversible and every member stays blocked, but Resource Successor Barrier waits for exact readback from both routes. Once durable, each missing derived Receipt is explicit Namespace Generation Failure Domain Receipt Debt with immediate and 86,400-second alerts rather than a Barrier prerequisite.

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Qualification Namespace Generation Failure Domain Fence Publication Reconciliation**:
The sole forward-only state after a Namespace Generation Failure Domain Fence Record has committed but either custody route has not published and read back the exact bytes. Every member remains immediately and irreversibly fenced; reconciliation may retry only that Record and Barrier remains blocked until both routes agree, while rollback, a replacement Record, changed membership, single-route completion or per-member repair is forbidden. A damaged route may progress only through Artifact Repair from the sole fully verified route and the assigned Namespace Generation Failure Domain Fence Custody Repair Observation; the same Fence stays active and zero good copies permanently block the Barrier.

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Qualification Namespace Generation Failure Domain Fence Custody Repair Witness**:
The exact independently administered read-only witness identity pinned by the active Recovery Tool Registry while authority is healthy and assigned to observe one Fence custody repair class without executing that repair. Only the record-bound witness may emit its Fence Custody Repair Observation after complete digest, domain-root and two-route readback; if it is unavailable, unqualified or changed, Resource Successor Barrier remains blocked and no latest witness, recovery job, custodian, operator or incident-time identity may substitute. Conflicting valid observations derive Namespace Generation Failure Domain Fence Custody Repair Witness Integrity Incident.

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Qualification Namespace Generation Failure Domain Fence Custody Repair Witness Integrity Incident**:
The permanent dual-route security evidence produced when the exact record-bound Fence Custody Repair Witness emits conflicting valid digest, domain-root, generation or readback observations for one repair. It invalidates and requires qualification revocation of that witness with reason `fence_custody_repair_witness_integrity`, preserves every conflicting result, permanently blocks Resource Successor Barrier for that Fence and mandates Namespace Generation Failure Domain Fence Custody Repair Lineage Termination; retry, later Registry rotation, replacement witness, custodian choice or observation majority cannot complete it.

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Qualification Namespace Generation Failure Domain Fence Custody Repair Lineage Termination**:
The permanent terminal state of the exact Fence, exhausted-resource and Resource Successor lineage named by one Fence Custody Repair Witness Integrity Incident. Progress requires Namespace Generation Failure Domain Fence Custody Repair Lineage Candidate Carryover followed by locked-root recovery to create a fresh Root Recovery Receipt, Tool Registry and Namespace Generation lineage, while the old Fence, witness, revocation, conflict and consumed Candidate evidence remain permanent; unrelated valid Runtime authority is not terminated.

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Qualification Namespace Generation Failure Domain Fence Custody Repair Lineage Candidate Carryover**:
The Fence-specific projection of Root Recovery Candidate Recovery Lineage Carryover required before a fresh Receipt can follow Fence Custody Repair Lineage Termination. It adds every distinct Candidate Identity whose Receipt slot was consumed and whose qualification, fixture, cleanup, Profile or Success Receipt depended on the terminated Fence lineage, including a formerly successful identity, with complete Component Provenance and Component Index associations while deduplicating every identity already barred; a never-started identity is excluded. The resulting Set must still satisfy the ordinary three-position Capacity Reserve before the fresh Receipt receives its normal at-most-three-slot budget; old remaining slots never transfer, and missing Set capacity derives Root Recovery Candidate Recovery Lineage Set Capacity Exhaustion rather than a truncated Set or reduced Receipt.

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Qualification Namespace Generation Failure Domain Fence Custody Repair Observation**:
The assigned immutable observation after Artifact Repair conditionally restores one missing or corrupt Fence Record custody copy byte-for-byte from the sole fully verified route and recomputes the exact record digest and domain root. The Fence remains active throughout and Resource Successor Barrier waits for this Observation plus complete two-route readback; zero good copies, a reconstructed record, changed membership or another observer permanently blocks the Barrier.

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Qualification Namespace Generation Failure Domain Receipt Debt**:
The non-authoritative audit state for one member whose deterministic per-resource exhaustion Receipt is still absent after its Fence Record is dual-route durable. **Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Qualification Namespace Generation Failure Domain Receipt Debt Alert**:
The one at-most-64-KiB daily aggregate audit artifact per Fence Record containing the complete sorted current debt-member set, count and domain-separated root rather than one alert per member. Every Alert reserves its checked sequence before publication; inability to reserve the next aggregate Alert derives Namespace Generation Failure Domain Receipt Debt Alert Capacity Exhaustion.

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Qualification Namespace Generation Failure Domain Receipt Debt Alert Capacity Exhaustion**:
The permanent governance predicate produced when the checked audit sequence cannot reserve the next daily aggregate Receipt Debt Alert for one Fence Record. The already durable Fence, completed Resource Successor Barrier and existing otherwise valid Runtime authority remain unchanged, but every new governance or Policy authority is blocked; only a wider alert schema already fully active under healthy authority before exhaustion can continue, never a new chain, compaction, dropped history or incident-time activation.

**Compatibility Custody Root Recovery Qualification Namespace Generation Integrity Incident**:
The permanent provider-contract violation derived when the two independent cleanup jobs return unequal Exact-Generation Namespace Emptiness Assertion tokens in one completed Issue, or when a later Issue returns a different token after a zero-delete predecessor without an exact old-token/successful-state-changing-conditional-delete-Receipt/new-token transition. It consumes no additional Cleanup Issue ordinal and atomically commits one Namespace Generation Failure Domain Fence Record over one exact Registry head and complete Namespace Generation Failure Domain: every active or pending tuple sharing the exact provider, Exact-Generation Namespace Emptiness Assertion implementation identity and control-plane generation is fenced, with each claimed namespace root, account and Capacity Reservation permanently `QUARANTINED_EXHAUSTED`; an independently qualified profile outside that exact triple remains eligible. Every concurrent or later activation rechecks the Authority incident index before its CAS; per-tuple asynchronous fencing or partial visibility is forbidden. It permits no cleanup or release, and after the Resource Successor Barrier proves every old authority inert requires a different healthy-period-qualified Resource Successor Standby. If a Candidate credential delivery or execution began in the affected tuple, that Candidate Identity and Attempt Chain are permanently invalid; a pure Readiness Drill or Standby Drill with no Candidate has no Candidate effect. Timeout or one missing job remains merely incomplete rather than this Incident. The triggering transaction is guaranteed encodable by the activation-time 256-member and at-most-64-KiB Fence-Record reserve. Once the Record is dual-route durable it alone satisfies the Resource Successor Barrier for all listed resource fences; derived per-resource Receipts are mandatory alerted audit backfill and never authority or a Barrier prerequisite. A tuple that changed triples is classified only through its atomic Failure Domain Membership Transfer at the certified head. After the Fence commit, partial route publication enters Namespace Generation Failure Domain Fence Publication Reconciliation and keeps the Barrier blocked despite immediate fencing; after both routes agree, missing derived Receipts become Namespace Generation Failure Domain Receipt Debt with no Barrier authority.
