**Compatibility Custody Adapter Closure**:
The exact Execution Bundle file subset whose bytes can affect provider dispatch, correlation, query, pagination, time interpretation, or declared cancellation behavior. It is a strict canonical artifact under domain `turnvector.compatibility-custody-adapter-closure`, whose root `format_version` begins at one and equals its framed version and whose sorted entries bind path, mode, length, and SHA-256 for every Bundle file carrying the `adapter` role. Any closure-byte change requires a new Provider Contract Record; a finalizer- or reconciler-only change may reuse the Record only when the Closure identity is identical.
_Avoid_: Execution Bundle Identity, adapter version label, source directory

**Compatibility Custody Bundle File Role**:
One member of the sorted unique nonempty role set on every Execution Bundle file: `adapter`, `finalizer`, or `reconciler`. A file may carry multiple roles, every dependency loaded by provider-facing code must carry `adapter`, and an entry without a role or with an unknown role makes the manifest invalid.
_Avoid_: Directory role, inferred executable purpose, free-form component label

**Compatibility Custody System Dependency**:
A Mach-O dependency resolved only from the platform dyld shared cache, `/System/Library`, or `/usr/lib` under the declared compatible macOS envelope. Every other dependency must be a manifest file with all roles of its loading entrypoint. Bundle validation combines the complete static Mach-O load graph with an exact Compatibility Custody Load Audit Qualification Record. Every invocation records that qualified source identity, first and last event sequence, and `drop_count == 0` across the entire process lifetime; any gap, loss, unavailable audit capability, `DYLD_*`, or `@rpath` outside the sealed Bundle makes conformance fail.
_Avoid_: Homebrew library, runner SDK, ambient search path

**Compatibility Custody Load Audit Qualification Record**:
The at-most-64-KiB strict canonical protected-CI artifact under domain `turnvector.compatibility-custody-load-audit-qualification`, permanently published in Git as `compatibility-custody/load-audit/<64hex-record-id>.json`. It binds exact macOS build, CPU architecture, Tool Execution Profile, OS load-event source identity, fixture Hash, complete result of loading and unloading 256 images under buffer pressure, and Custody Object IDs for the full raw event stream retained with the conformance result in primary and cold custody. Success requires bounded source sequence coverage and `drop_count == 0` for every fixture process. The Profile and Provider Contract Record bind its exact identity; it has no independent time expiry, while any OS build, CPU, Profile, event-source identity, fixture-byte, sequence gap, or drop-count change requires a new successful Record before invocation.
_Avoid_: CI log, static Mach-O scan, runtime best effort

**Compatibility Custody Provider Contract Revocation**:
The permanent irrevocable Ledger record under domain `turnvector.compatibility-custody-provider-contract-revocation` targeting exactly one Provider Contract Record identity or one Adapter Closure identity, where closure scope covers every matching Contract Record and no provider wildcard exists. Only a compatibility-owner-reviewed PR and protected CI job may create it; the record binds one Compatibility Custody Revocation Reason, bounded evidence URI and digest, authorizing CI identity, and `revocation_authorization_time`, while direct CLI append is forbidden. Presence in the current valid chain invalidates every matching success for future reader retirement regardless of Job end time, blocks new Open and any not-yet-started dispatch immediately, but neither reverses an already completed retirement nor changes an existing Runtime. Authorization time orders dispatch races; an already-started call may return, after which exact query reconciles any discovered Job without cancellation solely because of revocation. Record-scoped recovery requires a new conformance Record, closure-scoped recovery requires changed Closure bytes and identity plus new conformance, and no Unrevoke or deletion exists.
_Avoid_: Contract expiry, deleting a Contract Record, abandoning an Open

**Compatibility Custody Infrastructure Qualification Revocation**:
The permanent irrevocable Ledger record under domain `turnvector.compatibility-custody-infrastructure-qualification-revocation` targeting exactly one Coordination Store Qualification Record, Coordination Restore Generation Authority, Host Fetcher Driver Qualification Record, or Secret Broker Profile identity, with no kind, provider, service, driver, lineage, or version wildcard. It consumes only a Ledger sequence not reserved for an unresolved Open Terminal. The same protected PR/CI authority, stable Revocation Reason, bounded evidence URI/digest, and authorization-time ordering as Provider Contract Revocation apply. A Coordination Equivocation Incident makes publication of the exact implicated Qualification Revocation mandatory and supplies its two-Certificate evidence digest; the Root Authority incident already freezes new work, so merge delay or refusal never restores authority. At or after `revocation_authorization_time`, every new Open and any dispatch whose provider network call has not begun is blocked immediately; delivery of a provider-adapter credential does not grandfather egress and that credential is revoked or allowed to expire unused. A known or already-started Job still reconciles but cannot qualify retirement. An ordinary noncompromised qualification target recovers through a fresh non-revoked successor in the same lineage. An equivocated Coordination service or compromised Restore Generation Authority never recovers in place: protected governance first makes this exact Revocation current-tree valid, then creates a new independently administered Authority when applicable and Coordination service/key identity, publishes the Service Replacement Receipt after old-identity isolation, qualifies it, activates a later Policy and `NORMAL` mode, and only then reconciles every unresolved Attempt and evidence subject without selecting a conflicting branch. No Unrevoke, key rotation under the compromised identity, deletion, target substitution, fork choice, manual counter copy, compound gate, or direct CLI append exists. Candidate notarization/signing revocation or immutable secret-version deletion targets the exact Secret Broker Profile with reason `candidate_notarization_revoked` or `secret_version_unavailable`. New Policy, credential delivery and calls not yet begun stop immediately; already-started calls only reconcile under their existing deadline, and no restapling, alias fallback or same-Profile repair exists.
Candidate notarization/signing revocation, Candidate Installation Trust Disagreement and immutable-version deletion require exact Infrastructure Qualification Revocation Evidence and target reasons `candidate_notarization_revoked`, `candidate_installation_trust_disagreement` and `secret_version_unavailable` respectively. The target-kind registry additionally admits the exact Fence Custody Repair Witness identity for Witness Integrity Incident with reason `fence_custody_repair_witness_integrity`; this never authorizes a replacement witness for an existing Fence. Infrastructure Qualification Status Disagreement immediately blocks new authority for the exact target but cannot publish this permanent Revocation until two-job evidence agrees. Deletion after a matching issuance reached `COMMITTED` never rewrites that issuance: provider-native delivery evidence selects its terminal, otherwise expiry leads to `DELIVERY_UNKNOWN_EXPIRED`, and neither the Revocation nor deletion implies `NOT_DELIVERED`.
_Avoid_: Provider Contract Revocation, deleting a qualification file, wildcard infrastructure ban

**Compatibility Custody Infrastructure Qualification Revocation Evidence**:
The permanent dual-route evidence supporting one exact Infrastructure Qualification Revocation, produced only when two independently administered jobs obtain provider-native exact identity, immutable-version and status readbacks and agree on the same revocation, signing loss or deletion fact and trusted observation window. For `candidate_installation_trust_disagreement`, the two otherwise valid contradictory verifier results and their shared Candidate, Policy and observation-window bindings are themselves the required two-job evidence; neither result is selected. A single API failure, timeout, status page, ticket, operator statement or one-job result is `INCOMPLETE`; authority changes only through the exact current-tree Revocation record bound to this evidence, never through an alias or local cache.
Contradictory provider-native status results derive Infrastructure Qualification Status Disagreement and do not satisfy this Evidence. The exact conflicting signed Fence witness observations themselves satisfy two-source evidence for reason `fence_custody_repair_witness_integrity` without selecting either observation.
_Avoid_: One-job revocation, provider ticket, transient API failure

**Compatibility Custody Infrastructure Qualification Status Disagreement**:
The permanent dual-route evidence and active fail-closed predicate created when two independently administered Revocation jobs return otherwise valid contradictory provider-native status for the same exact qualification identity, immutable version and observation window, or when the two Root Recovery verifiers return contradictory Same-Identity Requalification Eligibility for one exact post-success Broker Profile and canonical Candidate projection. It immediately blocks new authority for that target without selecting either result, consuming a Candidate slot or publishing permanent Revocation; only Infrastructure Qualification Status Disagreement Resolution may produce Revocation Evidence, prove current validity or resolve the exact requalification predicate, while majority, continued use, operator choice and one-result retry are invalid.
_Avoid_: One-job revocation, status majority, continued disputed qualification

**Compatibility Custody Infrastructure Qualification Status Disagreement Resolution**:
The immutable dual-route result from one Infrastructure Qualification Status Resolution Attempt Chain entry. For provider status, two fresh independently administered Revocation jobs within one at-most-300-second trusted observation window agree on the exact qualification identity, immutable version and provider-native status. For post-success Same-Identity requalification, both fresh Root Recovery verifier jobs agree on the exact Profile, Candidate Component Canonicalization, changed-field projection and Eligibility predicate in the same window. At most one Resolution attempt may be active; every complete or incomplete attempt is permanent and a later operator-triggered attempt uses wholly fresh jobs and observations. An agreed revoked result may support Infrastructure Qualification Revocation Evidence, an agreed current result clears only the active status block, an agreed eligible result permits the slot-free lane, and an agreed ineligible result requires the changed-identity path without Candidate failure. One job, staggered windows, cached status, operator choice, Candidate-slot consumption or deletion of the predecessor is invalid.
_Avoid_: One-result status clearing, rewritten disagreement, stale resolution window

**Compatibility Custody Infrastructure Qualification Status Resolution Attempt Chain**:
The dedicated append-only checked-`u64` predecessor chain of every Resolution attempt for one Infrastructure Qualification Status Disagreement, with at most one active attempt and a prospective capacity reservation for its start plus mutually exclusive agreed, disagreed or incomplete terminal. Every terminal remains permanent, late results from an older attempt cannot enter a later one, and no compaction, wrap, counter reset or elapsed-time escalation exists. If a complete next attempt and terminal no longer fit, Infrastructure Qualification Status Resolution Attempt Chain Capacity Exhaustion leaves the target blocked; capacity exhaustion never selects current status or creates Revocation.
_Avoid_: Unbounded status files, three-attempt revocation, reused status job result

**Compatibility Custody Infrastructure Qualification Status Resolution Attempt Chain Capacity Exhaustion**:
The permanent terminal for one exact infrastructure qualification identity when its Status Resolution Attempt Chain cannot reserve a complete next attempt and terminal. It preserves the unresolved Status Disagreement and blocks every new governance action depending on that qualification, without widening, resetting or interpreting the old chain. A genuinely new immutable infrastructure version may enter a wholly fresh ordinary qualification and independent chain, but inherits no current/revoked status, evidence result, identity continuity or clearing authority from the exhausted predecessor.
_Avoid_: Status-chain widening, version-label retry, inherited current status

**Compatibility Custody Revocation Reason**:
The stable nonzero `u32` identity in its own repository-tracked append-only registry. Initial values mean `provider_contract_breach`, `credential_compromise`, `custody_artifact_mismatch`, `adapter_defect`, `operator_emergency`, and `coordination_equivocation`; meanings are never reused. A Coordination Equivocation Incident requires the exact `coordination_equivocation` value and both conflicting Certificate digests rather than a generic compromise reason. Its evidence URI is at most 512 ASCII bytes and is either exact HTTPS or a strict repo-relative path, and the record separately binds the evidence digest. Additional permanent values mean `candidate_notarization_revoked`, `candidate_installation_trust_disagreement` and `secret_version_unavailable`; none can use the generic operator-emergency value or be reused for another meaning.
Another permanent value means `fence_custody_repair_witness_integrity`; it applies only to the exact record-bound witness and conflicting signed observations.
_Avoid_: Free-form reason, HTTP status, mutable incident ticket

**Compatibility Custody Reconciliation Horizon**:
The checked-`u64` Unix-second interval from dispatch deadline through inclusive Horizon end, computed by adding the Open's default seven-day grace constrained to 1-30 days. Provider retention must cover it, and only a complete query whose trusted end time falls within that interval may prove `NOT_DISPATCHED`. A later zero or missing result never proves absence. Ordinary reconciliation stops querying at Horizon; only a read-only Disaster Lease may perform the separately bounded post-Horizon query, whose result can support conservative failure finalization but never `NOT_DISPATCHED` or retirement qualification.
_Avoid_: Dispatch window, CI artifact retention, automatic timeout success

**Compatibility Custody Execution Bundle**:
The self-contained provider-adapter, finalizer, and reconciler machinery identified under domain `turnvector.compatibility-custody-execution-bundle-manifest` by a canonical manifest of at most 256 ordinary files. It declares one CPU architecture, inclusive minimum and maximum compatible macOS versions, and exactly one `adapter_entrypoint`, `finalizer_entrypoint`, and `reconciler_entrypoint`; each names a `0555` file carrying the matching role, and one multi-role file may satisfy multiple fields. Each strict relative ASCII path is at most 512 bytes, each nonempty segment is at most 128 bytes and uses only `[A-Za-z0-9._+-]` without `.` or `..`; every entry binds a Bundle File Role set, exact `0444` or `0555` mode, checked length at most 1 GiB, and SHA-256, while checked aggregate bytes are at most 2 GiB and manifest bytes at most 256 KiB. Directories are implicit and links, special files, xattr dependencies, archive layout, tags, and locations are excluded. The remote logical object is this manifest plus independent digest-addressed file blobs; OCI layer order, transport packaging, and cold-store layout never enter identity. Exact policy bytes, source, manifest, build recipe, and digests remain permanent Git evidence; both indefinitely retained primary and cold copies must verify before a new Open, while an existing Open may reconcile from either correct copy and a missing peer blocks only later Opens until repaired.
_Avoid_: CI cache, opportunistic rebuild, Compatibility Tool bundle

**Compatibility Custody Bundle Materialization**:
The deterministic creation of an Execution Bundle at its digest-addressed path: under `umask 077`, the protected runner writes a unique same-volume `0700` staging tree owned by its effective UID/GID, rejects every ACL and xattr, verifies manifest, static/runtime dependency closure, and every byte before use, applies each file's fixed mode and `0555` to implicit directories, synchronizes files and directories, and atomically publishes the sealed tree. Mach-O signature bytes participate only in File Hash and create no trust root. If the final digest path exists, full exact verification permits reuse and any mismatch blocks as local corruption without replacement or suffix. A sealed local tree is a non-authoritative cache removable only without an active process or materialization lease; execution never starts from a download cache, partially populated tree, or mutable path.
_Avoid_: Archive extraction in place, executable cache, lazy verification

**Compatibility Custody Tool Invocation ID**:
The fresh random 128-bit identity generated by the protected runner for one provider-adapter, Finalizer, or Reconciler tool process, encoded as 16 bytes in Protocol messages and 32 lowercase hexadecimal digits in evidence. It is unique and collision-checked within its Attempt, and the runner has a trusted obligation not to intentionally reuse it across Attempts without claiming permanent historical detectability after evidence retention. Its request binds exact Attempt and Open identities, Dispatch Correlation ID, role, invocation ordinal, absolute operation deadline, Attested Job Identity, CI Policy, Provider Contract, Execution Bundle, Tool Process Protocol, and Tool Execution Profile identities. The matching typed response must echo the exact ID and bindings; any mismatch is a Protocol Violation. PID, CI job ID, retry number alone, or a previous Invocation ID never substitutes.
_Avoid_: Dispatch Correlation ID, process ID, reusable request ID

**Compatibility Custody Tool Process Protocol**:
The single-request process boundary shared by all three Bundle entrypoints under domain `turnvector.compatibility-custody-tool-process-protocol`, initially major 1/minor 0 with manifest-bound canonical descriptor Hash and independent 1-MiB request and response maxima. Open binds one exact major, minor, and descriptor Hash; the runner either implements that complete descriptor or rejects before launch, with no runtime negotiation or compatible-version inference. Typed request/response `oneof` variants are exactly `adapter`, `finalizer`, and `reconciler`; request and response carry the exact Tool Invocation ID, Attested Job Identity, and all other Invocation bindings, and entrypoint-role or echoed-binding mismatch is a Protocol Violation. The orchestrator executes directly without a shell; stdin is `/dev/null`, stdout/stderr are diagnostics whose first byte beyond either 1-MiB cap terminates the process, descriptor 3 is read-only request, 4 write-only response, and 5 supplies one Invocation-ID-bound length-prefixed opaque provider credential of at most 64 KiB then EOF; every other inherited descriptor closes. The secret broker issues that credential for exactly the Open, provider, role, Attested Job Identity, and Invocation ID, with expiry at the operation deadline plus the five-second exit grace; it is never refreshed, transferred, or reused. Request and exactly one Terminal Response use four-byte big-endian length-prefixed Protobuf. The complete response frame must arrive by the operation deadline, then descriptor 4 EOF and process exit zero must both occur within the grace. Nonzero, signal, missing/extra response, descriptor misuse, message/log oversize, deadline, or response followed by crash is invocation failure and never erases possible provider side effects. Credentials never enter environment, files, or artifacts. The child otherwise receives only fixed C locale, UTC, private `TMPDIR`, Invocation ID, and Bundle identity.
_Avoid_: Shell command, stdout JSON protocol, inherited CI environment

**Compatibility Custody Tool Execution Profile**:
The fail-closed build-owned canonical artifact under domain `turnvector.compatibility-custody-tool-execution-profile`, binding exact host enforcement mechanisms, process/file/network rules, quotas, Contract-authorized CIDRs, and one Load Audit Qualification Record for every Bundle entrypoint; Provider Contract and Open bind its identity. It denies subprocess creation and filesystem access outside the sealed Bundle and one invocation-private `TMPDIR` capped at 4 GiB and 16,384 objects. For direct origin mode, the runner resolves the exact host once per invocation, accepts 1-16 sorted unique final A/AAAA addresses only when every address falls within a Contract-bound CIDR, records addresses, TTLs, resolver configuration and bounded CNAME chain, limits egress to that pinned set and implicit port 443, and fixes HTTP Host and TLS SNI; TTL expiry never changes this invocation and only a later invocation resolves again. Proxy mode permits only the bound proxy, plus required system DNS/TLS services. After credential delivery and immediately before enabling the first provider egress, enforcement obtains and atomically consumes a provider-egress Root Boundary Permit bound to the Open, Invocation, Proof, Intent, service/Epoch/mode, and exact Lock generation; a delivered credential or merely issued Permit is not a started call and is revoked, fenced, or allowed to expire unused on failure. Only after successful consume and the first provider network call actually begins may that call finish under its existing deadline, after which ordinary exact-query reconciliation remains mandatory. On any process, protocol, deadline, log, filesystem, network, or quota violation, enforcement sends `SIGSTOP`, revokes egress and descriptors, then sends `SIGKILL` without `SIGTERM` and waits at most five seconds to reap the child; possible provider side effects remain unknown. Failure to prove the PID gone inside that bound permanently disqualifies the runner job, which is destroyed without further invocation; reconciliation may continue only on another independently qualified runner. After every exit the runner removes the TMPDIR. Cleanup failure withholds success and disqualifies the runner. An ephemeral runner is destroyed without reading, archiving, or uploading residue; a non-ephemeral host remains quarantined until audited deletion and complete requalification. A provider-adapter attempt always enters exact-query reconciliation. Provider credentials remain only on descriptor 5; if the host cannot enforce or prove the Profile, the tool does not run and conformance cannot pass.
_Avoid_: Cleared environment, ordinary CI runner, application self-discipline

**Compatibility Custody OIDC Verifier Profile**:
The at-most-64-KiB strict canonical permanent Git artifact under domain `turnvector.compatibility-custody-oidc-verifier-profile`, published as `compatibility-custody/oidc-verifiers/<64hex-profile-id>.json`. It fixes exact HTTPS issuer and JWKS URL, accepted signature algorithms, audience construction, required claim schema and normalization, token-age bounds, system TLS validation, and a JWKS cache lifetime at most 21,600 seconds. It pins no individual signing key. A validation records the exact canonical JWK-set digest used; an unknown key triggers one live refresh, and refresh failure may use only an unexpired previously verified cache. Coordination and Broker must consume one operation using the same exact JWK-set digest. An initial mismatch makes both independently refresh once; continued mismatch blocks the operation and requires a new Challenge rather than accepting either view or adding a voter. When the issuer supplies authenticated version or validator ordering, a provably older response cannot replace a newer cached observation. Without such issuer metadata, the system records bounded seen-set digests and times but invents no global JWKS order; exact per-operation agreement remains the authority rule. Cache expiry plus unavailable, invalid, or persistently disagreeing JWKS blocks every new Attested Job Identity. Issuer, URL, algorithm, claims, audience, or cache-policy change creates a new Profile and qualification.
_Avoid_: Pinned leaf signing key, unbounded JWKS cache, issuer-only validation

**Compatibility Custody Attestation Challenge**:
The fresh random 128-bit one-operation Coordination record created only after the service validates one predeclared bounded operation Intent, fresh Current-Tree Authorization Proof, permitted Coordination Service Mode, required job role, and an atomically consumed Challenge-creation Root Boundary Permit. The ordinary form also requires current CI Policy and Owner Registry. After repository-root recovery it may serve only the descriptor-ordered Host Fetcher and Coordination qualification steps and only after the fresh Secret Broker Profile is current; the first Broker qualification instead uses the dedicated Root Recovery Qualification Challenge and Verifier Set. The recovery form binds the current Recovery Receipt, Bootstrap Descriptor, new Owner Registry, fresh Broker Profile and exact next candidate and Qualification Test Namespace and grants no production credential or service mutation. The Challenge binds Service Epoch, Proof and Permit identities and expiries, complete operation Intent Hash and optional Mutation ID, role, exact OIDC audience containing service identity and challenge, and an expiry no later than 300 seconds after server creation or either bound expiry. In `QUALIFICATION_ONLY`, creation is restricted to the selected qualification identity and exact Qualification Test Namespace; ordinary operations require `NORMAL`. It has separate `coordination` and `broker` consumption slots. Each verifier independently validates the same token and compare-and-swap consumes its own slot exactly once with token, normalized-claims, Profile, and JWK-set digests. Both slots must agree exactly. A repeated or different digest, wrong role/audience, expired Proof, Permit, or Challenge, third consumer, cross-operation use, wrong recovery order, pre-Broker use, or verifier disagreement terminalizes that Challenge as rejected, issues no credential, performs no requested mutation, and preserves both authentication-free observations through expiry. Retry begins only after any live key refresh with a fresh token, job, Proof, Permit, and Challenge; neither verifier adopts the other's result and no third voter exists. A minimal consumed or rejected tombstone remains through token expiry, and neither token nor bearer bytes persist. Owner Registry bootstrap instead uses its domain-separated Repository Bootstrap Intent and Owner Approvals and never depends on this record.
_Avoid_: Reusable bearer token, run-ID-only nonce, client-generated challenge

Before issue, the Authority validates a fresh Current-Tree Authorization Proof covering the applicable Owner Registry, Policy or Infrastructure Revocation and Service Replacement intent and atomically consumes a Challenge-creation Root Boundary Permit for the exact `UNLOCKED` Lock generation. The Challenge binds that Proof and Permit, Authority and service identities, current generation/revision or typed `NO_PREDECESSOR`, restored snapshot digest, planned Service Epoch, job role, OIDC Verifier Profile, audience, and an expiry no later than 300 seconds or either bound expiry. Authority and Secret Broker independently validate the same token and consume separate `restore_authority` and `broker` slots with identical token, normalized-claims, Profile, and JWK-set digests before deriving the restore publisher's Attested Job Identity. Reuse, mismatch, wrong intent, fenced Permit, or expiry rejects without CAS or credential. Loss or unavailability of Lock Authority, Restore Authority, or Broker blocks the operation; Owner Approval, preissued or offline token, manual credential, and ordinary CI secret cannot substitute. Its namespace shares the Authority's quorum, backup exclusion, and linearizability but grants no ordinary Coordination read, mode transition, service mutation, lease, general credential purpose, or Open authority. Qualification proves full Coordination loss, Challenge and Permit issue/consume, proof/Permit expiry, Lock change, Authority/Broker unavailability or disagreement, replay, typed genesis, and same-intent CAS recovery.

**Compatibility Custody Broker Issuance Audit**:
The authentication-free canonical broker entry produced for every credential issuance attempt, binding Broker Profile and service revision, exact Attested Job Identity, credential purpose and scope, issue and expiry times, Attempt and Open plus Tool Invocation ID or publication, repair, or prune operation identity, and exactly one delivery outcome `delivered`, `failed_before_delivery`, or `uncertain`. It contains neither secret bytes nor a token, credential digest, reversible identifier, or other guessing oracle. `uncertain` is treated as possible credential exposure and never proves absence. For a provider adapter, it forces the Open into exact `QUERY`; retry is permitted only when audit proves `failed_before_delivery` and the old credential is expired or explicitly revoked, and that retry uses a fresh Tool Invocation ID. Other roles reconcile their exact external operation before requesting another credential. Attempt entries are committed as `COORDINATION_EVIDENCE` and their digests enter the Attempt Artifact Manifest; publication, repair, and prune receipts bind the applicable entry digest, and `ABORTED_PREOPEN` proof requires complete absence of both `delivered` and `uncertain` provider-adapter credential issuance.
_Avoid_: Secret log, credential fingerprint, CI job console output

**Compatibility Custody Artifact Repair Type Registry**:
The append-only versioned protected-current-tree registry under Artifact Repair Type Registry Schema that alone makes an artifact type eligible for Compatibility Custody Artifact Repair. Each entry fixes the typed Object identity and canonical reader, required custody routes and Certificate, exact one-good-copy repair algorithm, conditional-write and readback rules, Receipt projection, any witness or compound-root check, and one explicit zero-good-copy terminal or permanent authority block. Version one covers the artifact types and specialized Graph, Fence, Audit Resolution Commit, Root Authority History, Repository Root Recovery Evidence Extension Manifest Artifact Repair and pending Schema Successor staging-page rules named by Artifact Repair; later types enter only through Artifact Repair Type Registry Successor with complete Capacity Reserve and Artifact Repair Type Qualification Evidence before any loss or incident. Existing entries and their terminals cannot be edited, generalized or weakened, and an unknown type, ambiguous version or absent zero-good rule is ineligible rather than repaired. The active Registry root, activated Registry pages and selected manifest are never Artifact-Repair-eligible: corrupt bytes, root/count mismatch, ambiguous current version or impossible partial active successor derives Repository Root Integrity Incident and requires last-good-tree restoration rather than recursive repair or hardcoded fallback. Only immutable not-yet-authoritative Schema Successor staging pages qualify under their preexisting distinct version-one rule.
_Avoid_: Generic repair eligibility, incident-time type registration, implicit zero-good policy

**Compatibility Custody Artifact Repair Type Registry Schema**:
The fixed canonical paged encoding for Artifact Repair Type Registry version one, with at-most-64-KiB pages, entries ordered by typed artifact identity then rule version, checked-`u64` entry/page/byte counts, immutable prior-entry references and one domain-separated compound root. Each entry contains every one-good algorithm, zero-good terminal, reader, route, Certificate, write/readback, Receipt and witness field required by the Registry; duplicate type/version, mutable default, omitted rule, unchecked count, variable page bound or interpretation outside the page bytes is invalid.
_Avoid_: Unbounded repair registry, mutable type default, unchecked registry count

**Compatibility Custody Artifact Repair Type Registry Capacity Reserve**:
The prospective nonborrowable current-tree and dual-route reservation for one complete next Repair Type Registry entry, all resulting pages and manifest/root changes, Qualification Evidence references, publication/readback receipts and one mutually exclusive successor terminal before Registry Successor begins. Admission also proves Artifact Repair Type Registry Schema Successor Headroom Reserve remains fully intact after the worst-case entry commits. A partial entry, expected page deduplication, later allocation, schema-successor headroom, ordinary repair headroom or capacity borrowed from an artifact's Retention Charge cannot satisfy it. A proposal that would cross the headroom floor starts nothing and derives Artifact Repair Type Registry Capacity Alert rather than consuming the protected reserve.
_Avoid_: Partial repair-type reserve, dedup-funded registry entry, artifact-charge borrowing

**Compatibility Custody Artifact Repair Type Registry Schema Successor Headroom Reserve**:
The permanent healthy-root logical and dual-route physical reserve sized for one complete worst-case checked-`u128` Artifact Repair Type Registry Schema Successor, every imported page/reference and reader fixture, its publication/readback receipts and one complete ordinary Registry entry under the new schema. It is established independently of per-entry Capacity Reserve and cannot fund a normal type, Artifact Repair, Retention Charge or other schema. Every Registry entry admission re-proves the full floor remains afterward; only the exact Schema Successor may consume it.
_Avoid_: Entry-funded schema widening, shared repair headroom, successor reserve borrowing

**Compatibility Custody Artifact Repair Type Registry Capacity Alert**:
The immediate current-tree and audit state emitted when a proposed new Registry entry would reduce uncharged capacity below Schema Successor Headroom Reserve or when independent readback shows the floor threatened. The proposal does not start, existing registered repairs remain usable, and healthy governance may only restore the floor or activate the checked-`u128` Schema Successor before another type admission. Alert acknowledgement, expected deduplication, smaller entry estimate or unused artifact repair capacity cannot reopen admission. Loss or inability to honor the already promised floor derives Artifact Repair Type Registry Capacity Exhaustion.
_Avoid_: Warning-only registry alert, acknowledged headroom deficit, best-case type admission

**Compatibility Custody Artifact Repair Type Qualification Evidence**:
The immutable two-job qualification result required before one new Repair Type Registry entry may activate. Using the exact proposed Tool Bundle, canonical reader, conditional writer, Receipt projection and zero-good terminal implementation, two independent jobs fetch identical Tool-Registry-pinned golden fixtures through both custody-route profiles and independently prove byte-identical one-good missing-target repair, one-good corrupt-generation conditional replacement, complete readback/Certificate/witness behavior and zero-good fail-closed terminal without production authority. Both result bytes, fixture roots and raw-log digests must agree and enter the Registry Successor. Schema review, mocked success without route semantics, one job, production incident execution or a zero-good rule inferred from another type is invalid.
_Avoid_: Review-only repair type, one-job repair fixture, incident-time zero-good test

**Compatibility Custody Artifact Repair Type Registry Successor**:
The one-active root-authorized current-tree transition that appends exactly one new immutable type/version entry to Artifact Repair Type Registry. It binds the exact predecessor schema/root/count, complete Artifact Repair Type Registry Capacity Reserve, intact Schema Successor Headroom Reserve, Artifact Repair Type Qualification Evidence, Tool Registry, fresh Root Boundary Permit and Artifact Repair Type Registry Successor Terminal Ordering, publishes and reads back every changed page and manifest through both routes, and atomically selects the resulting root. Before any page or manifest publishes, Artifact Repair Type Registry Successor Cancellation may win; afterward cancellation is ineligible and only the same successor identity may reconcile forward. Existing entries remain byte-identical and the new type is ineligible until activation CAS commits. An in-place edit, two new entries, weakened zero-good terminal, post-incident registration, partial page activation or third current-tree state is invalid, with an impossible partial state deriving Repository Root Integrity Incident.
_Avoid_: In-place repair rule edit, multi-type registry append, incident-time registry successor

**Compatibility Custody Artifact Repair Type Registry Successor Cancellation**:
The explicit zero-publication current-tree terminal for one active Repair Type Registry Successor. Its deterministic transition binds the exact predecessor root/count, successor identity and unused Capacity Reserve, proves no changed Registry page, manifest, Receipt or external object published, leaves the active Registry byte-identical, closes the successor as `CANCELED` and releases only its exact unused per-entry reservation while preserving Schema Successor Headroom Reserve. After any successor publication it is permanently ineligible. Cancellation never deletes Qualification Evidence, changes an old entry or authorizes another successor before Terminal Ordering resolves.
_Avoid_: Post-publication registry cancel, deleted repair qualification, canceled headroom release

**Compatibility Custody Artifact Repair Type Registry Successor Terminal Ordering**:
The deterministic current-tree CAS order between one Registry Successor's activation and zero-publication cancellation transition IDs, both bound to the same predecessor and successor identity. Activation committed first makes cancellation fail permanently; cancellation committed first makes activation fail permanently. After any external successor publication, cancellation cannot commit and the same activation identity remains forward-only. Uncertain acknowledgement reconciles only the same transition ID: exact matching successor or cancellation proves the winner, unchanged predecessor permits only the same eligible transition retry, and any partial pages, mismatched ID, both terminals or third state derives Repository Root Integrity Incident. No cancel priority, activation priority, timeout or operator choice selects the outcome.
_Avoid_: Registry-cancel priority, registry-activation priority, dual repair-registry terminal

**Compatibility Custody Artifact Repair Type Registry Schema Successor**:
The healthy-root, pre-exhaustion schema transition funded only by Artifact Repair Type Registry Schema Successor Headroom Reserve that atomically replaces checked-`u64` Registry counts with checked-`u128` counts while retaining at-most-64-KiB pages. Before activation it imports every old entry, rule, Qualification Evidence reference and page identity through byte-identical Legacy Entry References under one compound root, proves every active Tool Bundle and recovery reader supports the new schema, fully reads back both routes and preserves capacity for one complete ordinary new-schema entry. After its first staging-page publication it enters Artifact Repair Type Registry Schema Successor Publication Reconciliation under the same exact identity and can no longer cancel or admit another successor; zero good copies of a required staging page derive Artifact Repair Type Registry Schema Successor Publication Capacity Terminal. It must activate before Artifact Repair Type Registry Capacity Exhaustion; no incident-time widening, headroom borrowing, dual-read, entry rewrite, counter reset or partial import is valid.
_Avoid_: Post-exhaustion registry widening, dual-read repair registry, rewritten repair rule

**Compatibility Custody Artifact Repair Type Registry Schema Successor Publication Reconciliation**:
The forward-only state after one Schema Successor staging page or manifest has first published but activation is not yet proved. Only the same successor identity may publish/read back remaining bytes, use the preexisting version-one staging-page repair rule for a single fully verified good copy, and retry its exact activation CAS; cancellation, a new successor, changed import root, headroom reuse or interpreting external page readback as active Registry authority is invalid. A matching activated root completes the transition, unchanged predecessor continues reconciliation, an impossible partial active root derives Repository Root Integrity Incident, and zero good staging copies derive Schema Successor Publication Capacity Terminal.
_Avoid_: Registry schema successor replacement, post-publication cancel, staging-page authority

**Compatibility Custody Artifact Repair Type Registry Schema Successor Publication Capacity Terminal**:
The permanent capacity terminal when two fresh Jobs prove a published required Schema Successor staging page or manifest has zero digest-valid custody copies under its preexisting repair rule. The exact successor identity, every published byte, failed page, import reference, Receipt and consumed Headroom Reserve remain permanent; the active predecessor Registry and all existing registered repair types remain usable, but no new type, successor or cancellation may consume or replace that reserved lineage. Only Artifact Repair Type Registry Recovery Lineage Genesis in a wholly fresh trust-root ceremony may establish a separate lineage; reconstruction, another same-lineage successor, headroom refund, partial activation or treating the loss as active-Registry corruption is invalid.
_Avoid_: Failed-schema headroom refund, replacement repair schema successor, reconstructed staging page

**Compatibility Custody Artifact Repair Type Registry Recovery Lineage Genesis**:
The new-trust-root ceremony boundary after Artifact Repair Type Registry Schema Successor Publication Capacity Terminal that creates a fresh Registry lineage rather than extending the terminal lineage. It imports every active predecessor entry, qualification, zero-good rule, terminal, published staging identity and charge as immutable read-only legacy evidence, independently requalifies every reader and repair implementation, fully publishes both routes and atomically activates only after exact semantic equality of all still-active entries; the old active Registry remains usable until then. Lost staging bytes, same-lineage continuation, entry omission, weakened terminal, inherited headroom or incident-time hardcoded repair is invalid.
_Avoid_: Same-lineage repair registry recovery, lost-page reconstruction, partially imported repair types

**Compatibility Custody Artifact Repair Type Registry Recovery Lineage Genesis Admission Boundary**:
The fixed scope boundary that admits only restoration and independent requalification of every still-active predecessor repair type into Recovery Lineage Genesis. No new repair type, changed rule or weakened zero-good terminal may enter that transition; additions wait for an ordinary Registry Successor after the recovered lineage is active.
_Avoid_: Recovery-genesis repair addition, bundled repair-rule change, incident-time new repair type

**Compatibility Custody Artifact Repair Type Registry Capacity Exhaustion**:
The permanent active-schema state when Schema Successor Headroom Reserve was never validly established, is lost or cannot fund the complete checked-`u128` Schema Successor plus its first ordinary entry. Valid per-entry admission cannot consume that floor. Exhaustion blocks only new artifact-type registration: every already active entry remains usable under its exact one-good and zero-good rules, and ordinary Artifact Repair, authority and Runtime behavior otherwise remain unchanged. Only a checked-`u128` Artifact Repair Type Registry Schema Successor already activated while healthy avoids the endpoint; exhaustion cannot select, truncate or merge a new entry, disable existing types, trigger recursive repair or create incident-time schema authority.
_Avoid_: Existing-repair shutdown, truncated repair type, exhaustion-time registry growth

**Compatibility Custody Artifact Repair**:
The protected external-storage maintenance operation that restores one missing or corrupt object only when its exact type and version are active in an integrity-valid Compatibility Custody Artifact Repair Type Registry and solely by that entry's fully fetched digest-verified one-good-copy rule. The active Registry itself is excluded and any active Registry integrity failure follows Repository Root Integrity Incident; immutable not-yet-authoritative Schema Successor staging pages remain a distinct pre-registered artifact type. Version one includes conformance-result, Execution Bundle, Attempt Artifact Manifest, retained Evidence Manifest Chunk, Intent Receipt, Head Transition Receipt or Cleanup Batch Receipt, final Disaster or Prune Evidence Manifest, Retention Recovery Evidence Manifest, Chunk Cleanup Evidence, one recovery-custody copy of an exact Root Authority History segment/checkpoint/Certificate, Credential Boundary Authority Graph pages, Namespace Generation Failure Domain Fence Record copies, Committed Credential Containment Audit Resolution Commit, Repository Root Recovery Evidence Extension Manifest pages and objects, and Artifact Repair Type Registry Schema Successor staging pages. Its ordinary broker credential is short-lived and scoped to one route and one Object ID, has no peer, list or delete authority, and appears in IAM Evidence as destructive only for that route; during Root Authority disaster, only the Registry-pinned Root Authority History Repair Capability may replace that unavailable Broker path. A missing target uses conditional create; a corrupt target may use only generation-match conditional replacement of the exact observed generation. Before replacement the tool reads the complete corrupt object when possible and permanently binds its observed generation token, checked length and full digest in a Compatibility Custody Artifact Repair Receipt without retaining corrupt bytes in Git; the disaster form instead binds the exact Capability, two custodian assertions and two recovery-job results, and detailed transfer evidence remains one year. Either path then performs a complete ordinary Artifact Fetch readback whose generation, length, digest and applicable Quorum Commit Certificate also enter the Receipt or disaster result. A Root Authority recovery-route repair additionally preserves the original Witness Inclusion Receipt and remains unusable on the repaired generation until the assigned witness emits the exact Custody Repair Observation; neither is replaced. Neither evidence form contains authentication material. Repair capacity must already exist in the exact route Reservation or Retention Charge; repair never borrows or creates capacity. Zero good peers, conflicting identity, invalid Certificate, or inability to verify the sole good object invokes the exact Registry entry's zero-good terminal and freezes every dependent recovery, Receipt, Exhaustion Record, cleanup, Charge release or governance decision; Git summaries, Heads, counts, receipts, logs, later Chunks and raw evidence cannot reconstruct its canonical bytes. Repair never mutates historical identities, Authority-native state or a Compatibility Custody Ledger record; later authorization still performs its own complete chain fetch and verification. Credential Boundary Authority Graph pages and Namespace Generation Failure Domain Fence Record copies remain subject to their registered type-specific rules: Graph repair recomputes the compound root, while Fence repair additionally requires its assigned Fence Custody Repair Observation before Barrier. Zero good copies of either cannot be reconstructed from Registry state, commit summaries or receipts.
Credential Boundary Authority Graph repair during Security Freeze additionally requires the exact active Graph Repair Capability outside the incident seed's provisional Closure, two independent jobs and two last-certified custodians, and produces Credential Boundary Graph Repair Completion Evidence before Closure Certification. Fence Record copy repair additionally binds the preincident Fence Custody Repair Witness; an unavailable assigned witness leaves Resource Successor Barrier blocked even after the copied bytes verify.
Committed Credential Containment Audit Resolution Commit is additionally Artifact-Repair-eligible only through its type-specific Resolution Commit Repair rule: one complete good Commit copy preserves the exact compound identity, while zero good copies cannot be reconstructed from its staged Resolution and Interval halves.
For that Commit type, two-job proof that both configured copies are explicitly absent or fully fetched but invalid derives Committed Credential Containment Audit Authority Chain Loss; route unavailability or disagreement only freezes dependent authority and never permits reconstruction or a loss terminal.
After last-good-tree restoration, any object generation produced by a repair type/version or transition absent from the selected ancestor becomes Repository Root Integrity Quarantined Repair Mutation. The repaired bytes and Receipt remain intact and charged but unavailable for authority or further repair until Repository Root Integrity Quarantined Repair Mutation Revalidation Proof commits under a newly and independently qualified matching Registry entry.
Version one also registers exact object, page and manifest types for Repository Root Recovery Identity Hash Schema Historical Reader Custody, Repository Root Recovery Bounded Disagreement Attempt Chain Schema Successors, Repository Root Recovery Governance Schema Reader Support Set successors, Repository Root Integrity Post-Ancestor Evidence Cut Source Set, Repository Root Integrity Post-Ancestor Evidence Cut Terminal Proof Registry, Repository Root Recovery Evidence Storage Successor Bootstrap Reserve and Fresh Custody Genesis, Root Recovery Candidate Downstream Attribution Probe Projection Derived-Proof Dependency Index and Late Proof Post-Ancestor Quarantine Successor Manifest, Provider Snapshot Response Evidence Allowlist successors and Provider Snapshot Response Evidence Allowlist Dependency Index. Each uses its named one-good-copy repair and zero-good terminal; no source code, fixture, derived root, Tool Registry entry, Proof, response projection, route inventory or predecessor page may reconstruct lost bytes.
_Avoid_: Compatibility Custody Attempt, Provider Contract Revocation, in-ledger repair

**Compatibility Custody Artifact Repair Receipt**:
The at-most-64-KiB strict canonical permanent Git artifact under domain `turnvector.compatibility-custody-artifact-repair-receipt`, published as `compatibility-custody/repairs/<64hex-receipt-id>.json`. It binds repair intent, Object ID, Routing and Host Fetcher identities, target route and credential-principal fingerprint, good-peer verification, pre-repair presence/generation/length/full digest when obtainable, exact conditional write outcome, post-repair generation/length/full readback digest, trusted times, tool build and raw-log digest. A Root Authority recovery-route form additionally binds Authority, segment/checkpoint/Certificate identities, original Witness Inclusion Receipt, assigned witness and expected Custody Repair Observation semantic projection without changing the original receipt or creating a Hash cycle. Unknown fields, missing required observation, authentication data, or receipt/path/identity mismatch invalidates it. Raw transfer logs remain outside Git for one year. Graph-page and Fence-Record forms additionally bind the graph/Fence identity, compound or domain root, exact sole-good-route proof and type-specific post-repair verification; the Fence form also binds the assigned Fence Custody Repair Observation projection.
_Avoid_: Repair log, overwritten object metadata, Compatibility Custody Record

A current Cleanup Receipt removes only its exact proved-absent intermediate inventory from later checks; an Exhaustion Record retains every still-present intermediate, Route Charge, required reader and permanent proof forever. For an Artifact-Repair-eligible custody object, exactly one fully verified peer automatically invokes the existing protected Artifact Repair from those exact bytes and requires its permanent Receipt plus complete peer readback. A recovery-custody History peer may be repaired byte-for-byte from the other fully verified route, preserving the original Inclusion Receipt and requiring the exact assigned witness's append-only Repair Observation before the new generation verifies; during disaster that repair must use the exact Registry-pinned History Repair Capability, two custodians and two jobs. No other witness substitutes, and permanent assigned-witness loss leaves the dependent route frozen inside the old Authority; only exact Witness Permanent Loss Evidence may select Disaster Bootstrap from a fully valid route without validating the repaired generation. Root-Authority-native history, Certificate, witness evidence, Handoff or Bootstrap disagreement is never repaired and instead freezes root authority for planned Replacement or Disaster Bootstrap. Zero good peers, invalid Certificate/Receipt/Observation, Effective Conflict Lock, unresolved Observation Key Incident, Clock Profile Drift, unresolved Observer Time-Basis Incident or Recovery, Bootstrap Issuer Randomness Incident lacking complete Randomness-Aborted Challenge or Standby Drill evidence, Issuer Ledger Integrity Incident, incomplete Committed Credential Containment Evidence, Namespace Generation Integrity Incident or incomplete/incorrect Failure Domain, or Observation Disagreement, witness disagreement or any identity ambiguity produces an alert and no write, and the exact dependent operation remains frozen. Inventory evidence is immutable but grants no Open, Terminal, recovery, Authority activation, Exhaustion, cleanup or Charge-release authority. Every new Open still performs full dual verification, and the formal quarterly Compatibility Custody Attempt remains independent. **Compatibility Custody Routing Identity**:
The identity of one strict canonical artifact under domain `turnvector.compatibility-custody-routing-map`, permanently appended as `compatibility-custody/routing/<64hex-routing-id>.json` with root `format_version` equal to its framed version. It contains exactly the six unique mappings in `{primary|cold} x {result|manifest|file_blob}`, with no wildcard, fallback, missing, or unused route, and all six endpoint-prefix byte strings are pairwise distinct. Each route also binds one build-owned Host Fetcher driver identity and fresh Qualification Record, strict driver-configuration schema and bytes, Secret Broker Profile credential scope, Contract-authorized CIDRs, and optional proxy. Each endpoint prefix is exact ASCII HTTPS using a lowercase DNS hostname and implicit port 443, with no userinfo, query, fragment, IP literal, explicit port, percent encoding, dot segment, or empty interior path segment; path segments use only URI-unreserved ASCII and the prefix ends in `/`. A Custody Object ID appends its digest directly. Attempt payload storage uses the primary and cold `file_blob` endpoints with the fixed disjoint suffix `attempts/<attempt-id>/payloads/<sha256>` and separate read/write/delete scopes; it is not a seventh mapping or a Custody Object ID. CI Policy binds one exact Routing Identity with no mutable current pointer; route change creates a new Map and Policy, while each existing Open retains its old Map. Failure Domain evidence is bound per route.
_Avoid_: Mutable URL in historical record, artifact digest, provider HTTP origin

**Compatibility Custody Object ID**:

**Compatibility Custody Dispatch Ambiguity**:
The terminal release-governance failure confirmed when one Dispatch Correlation ID resolves to 2-64 provider Job identities, binding the complete sorted Job set and exact query evidence. No Job or result is selected and every result is excluded from custody success. Optional containment visits the sorted explicitly running identities serially once each under the same five-second call and 330-second total deadlines, records the fixed per-identity cancellation outcome, performs no retry, and never gates terminal evidence or later retirement recovery.
_Avoid_: Retry, earliest Job selection, duplicate result

**Compatibility Custody Dispatch Query Overflow**:
The terminal release-governance failure produced when an exact provider query is incomplete, cyclic, repeats or violates a Job Identity or Page Token, exceeds any fixed binary maximum of 64 pages, 1 MiB identity-encoded body bytes, or 64 unique Jobs, or otherwise cannot prove one complete set. It binds bounded page/count evidence and the exact-response digest, excludes every result, and never deduplicates or truncates into Ambiguity. Optional containment visits only sorted at-most-64 unique identities fully obtained before first violation and explicitly reported running, serially once each with a five-second call timeout and 330-second total deadline; it performs no discovery or retry and records exactly `cancelled`, `rejected`, `timeout`, `error`, or `not_attempted_deadline` per identity without gating terminal evidence.
_Avoid_: Dispatch Ambiguity, truncated Job set, unbounded pagination

**Compatibility Custody Attempt Open Record**:
The immutable checked-successor Compatibility Custody Ledger entry under domain `turnvector.compatibility-custody-attempt-open`, created only after full-ledger validation, a fresh non-revoked Provider Contract Record for the exact host build, dual-custody verification, exact at-most-15-minute-old IAM Evidence identities, fresh non-revoked infrastructure Qualifications, one exact `NORMAL` `OPEN_PREPARED` Coordination Service Epoch and revision, fresh Current-Tree Authorization Proof, distinct consumed Open-prepare and Open-commit Root Boundary Permits, 192-MiB logical Attempt Artifact Reservation, independent qualified 192-MiB primary and cold Attempt Payload Route Reservations, valid Coordination Clock Calibration, and an at-most-300-second preflight. It reserves one Attempt identity and binds Correlation ID, tool, times, Horizon, preflight, Proof and Permits, Policy, Routing, Contract, Adapter Closure, Execution Bundle, Tool Process Protocol, Tool Execution Profile, IAM Evidence, Coordination Store, Restore Generation Advance or Service Replacement Receipt, Epoch, Service Mode and Qualification, Clock Calibration, exact root-selected Owner Registry with at least three active identities, Secret Broker Profile and OIDC Verifier Profile, Host Fetcher Qualifications, Terminal Reason and Evidence Role Registry Snapshot identities and at-most-16-major reader sets, `OPEN_PREPARED` revision, all three Reservation identities, complete Open Intent Hash, rebase count, and absolute intent expiry. Actual merge and `OPEN_COMMITTED` revalidate the Proof and consume fresh same-intent Permits; only later `OPEN_COMMITTED` initializes Phase State `OPEN` and permits dispatch. Git, Proof, Permit, or Lock failure creates no new authority; a delivered credential is fenced or expires unused, while only a provider call with consumed egress Permit that actually began retains possible effects and reconciles. Those exact semantics govern reconciliation until terminal.
_Avoid_: Compatibility Custody Record, CI job creation event, mutable pending row

**Compatibility Custody Attempt Artifact**:
The immutable non-authoritative detailed evidence for one Attempt, retaining authentication-free bounded request and response bodies plus Tool Process stdout and stderr for exactly 31,536,000 seconds after Terminal under its Compatibility Custody Attempt Artifact Reservation; its sealed Attempt Artifact Manifest remains permanently in primary and cold custody. One generated maximum-30-day schedule has exact-second sorted unique instants and at most 39 complete queries; only one Phase Lease is active, `QUERY` and `RESULT` worst cases remain mutually exclusive, and separate bounded `FINALIZE` evidence plus the schedule, cancellation, message, and log fixture must fit. Every logical payload uses one Compatibility Custody Evidence Append, is independently written and fully read back on primary and cold routes, and is atomically charged once without overwrite or truncation. Body digests, DNS/load-audit/IAM evidence, phase fencing, query snapshot/schedule/lateness evidence, and all primary and secondary terminal observations remain permanently bound by the compact Ledger Terminal through the Manifest Hash; authentication data is never captured. Artifact-store unavailability at or after Horizon leaves the Attempt unresolved until exact evidence and Manifest publication recover; Horizon never authorizes an evidence-free Terminal.
_Avoid_: Compatibility Custody Record, Provider Contract result artifact, secret-bearing CI log

**Compatibility Custody Evidence Role**:
The stable nonzero `u32` identity from one exact Evidence Role Registry Snapshot whose Registry Identity is `{major, registry_hash}`. Version one fixes `1 IAM_EVIDENCE`, `2 LOAD_AUDIT_RAW`, `3 DNS_EVIDENCE`, `4 TOOL_REQUEST`, `5 TOOL_RESPONSE`, `6 TOOL_STDOUT`, `7 TOOL_STDERR`, `8 HTTP_REQUEST`, `9 HTTP_RESPONSE`, `10 QUERY_PAGE`, `11 RESULT_EVIDENCE`, `12 CANCELLATION`, `13 FIXTURE_RESULT`, `14 BUNDLE_RESULT`, `15 CLONE_RESULT`, `16 RUNNER_ENFORCEMENT`, `17 COORDINATION_EVIDENCE`, and `18 TERMINAL_SECONDARY`. Each never-reused value fixes one compiled permitted-media set, per-entry byte maximum, per-Attempt count maximum, and retention class derived from the operation's existing binary maxima; Policy, runtime configuration, and an operator cannot override them. A new role only appends a new ID and Snapshot within a compatible major. Changing any existing role's media, size, count, retention, or meaning increments major. Open and Attempt Artifact Manifest bind the exact Snapshot identity. The current binary embeds current, immediately preceding two, and unresolved-Open-bound majors with a hard maximum of 16 total majors for this registry kind. If the required set already has 16, protected release and new-major Policy activation remain blocked until older Opens reach ordinary Terminal; a Compatibility Tool cannot serve an unresolved Open, no forced Terminal removes it, and no temporary seventeenth major exists. Existing Opens remain valid and ordinary Admission performs no version-count decision. Older closed majors are interpreted only by their permanent Compatibility Tool. An unsupported identity or value cannot seal, publish Terminal, or authorize retirement. A build-generated exact-size/count fixture applies the declared mutually exclusive QUERY/RESULT phase envelope and proves the checked sum of all simultaneous role maxima fits the 192-MiB Reservation. A free-form label, filename, MIME guess, unknown value, or role outside its declared bounds invalidates seal.
_Avoid_: Artifact filename, arbitrary tag, Tool Bundle File Role

**Compatibility Custody Evidence Append**:
The recoverable cross-service append identified by one Coordination Mutation and a stable append ID, binding Attempt, Reservation, Evidence Role Registry and value, ordinal, exact logical length, SHA-256, media type, and route-resolved payload path `attempts/<32-lowercase-hex-attempt-id>/payloads/<64-lowercase-hex-sha256>`. The Coordination Store advances `PREPARED -> PAYLOAD_WRITTEN -> COMMITTED`: `PREPARED` atomically reserves the logical bytes and maintains monotonic primary and cold route substates; separate Attested Job Identities, principals, and credentials conditionally create or verify each route and write complete readback receipts directly to Coordination. `PAYLOAD_WRITTEN` requires both route receipts, generations, lengths, and hashes, and `COMMITTED` makes the logical payload Manifest-eligible. Only before either final route payload exists, a deterministic rejection may instead advance `PREPARED -> ABORTED`, release those exact logical bytes, and require a separate ordinary dual-route committed `COORDINATION_EVIDENCE` append describing the failure. After either route write, abort is forbidden and recovery must finish the other route. Cross-Attempt deduplication is forbidden; identical payload within one Attempt is charged once and may be referenced by multiple entries. Crash or uncertain response resumes the same append and mutation until exact state is known. Manifest seal requires every append terminal at `COMMITTED` or `ABORTED`, includes only committed entries and both route references, and requires the committed evidence for each abort; inability to store that evidence leaves the Attempt unresolved.
_Avoid_: Write then account, global blob deduplication, directory discovery

**Compatibility Custody Attempt Artifact Manifest**:
The strict canonical artifact under domain `turnvector.compatibility-custody-attempt-artifact-manifest`, at most 4 MiB with at most 16,384 sorted unique entries and checked aggregate logical charged bytes at most 192 MiB including the Manifest itself. Its root binds format version, Attempt, Open, Reservation, Coordination Store, Epoch, and Evidence Role Registry identities, seal Coordination Mutation ID and resulting server revision, and exact total, but never an ephemeral Phase Lease token. Every entry binds registered Evidence Role, invocation or schedule ordinal, media type, checked logical length, SHA-256, and exact primary and cold Attempt-local payload paths, generations, readback hashes, and receipt identities. Under `FINALIZE`, the active lease holder first reconciles every Evidence Append and then atomically seals one immutable Manifest. The two isolated publication jobs permanently publish and read back the Manifest's own primary and cold Custody Object IDs before Terminal. If exactly one Manifest copy and receipt remain valid while the peer is missing or corrupt, Artifact Repair must copy from that exact fully verified good object; the peer publisher then performs ordinary complete readback and directly records its Object Publish Receipt. No Terminal may publish until both current Manifest copies have complete readback and one complete Publication Receipt Manifest proves both route outcomes. Terminal binds Manifest Hash, Object IDs, receipt identity, and charged bytes. A later `FINALIZE` lease may reuse that exact sealed and dual-verified Manifest after full verification. A build-generated maximum fixture simultaneously reaches 16,384 entries, 4 MiB Manifest bytes, 192 MiB logical charge, all six maximum IAM packages, the larger of maximum QUERY or RESULT evidence, and maximum FINALIZE evidence; inability to encode it fails the build. Unknown, duplicate, unsorted, secret-bearing, missing, uncommitted, uncharged, or unreferenced payload entries invalidate seal.
_Avoid_: Directory listing, mutable artifact index, compressed CI log archive

**Compatibility Custody Attempt Artifact Reservation**:
The Coordination Store quota record atomically reserving exactly 192 MiB of logical evidence for one Attempt ID before its Open under the Reservation namespace and a checked server revision, while binding one exact primary and one exact cold Attempt Payload Route Reservation. Failure or uncertainty in any of the three creates no Open, and capacity across them is never pooled. Once Open exists, crash recovery reconciles and resumes the same Reservations and no other Attempt may consume them. Every Evidence Append prepares, writes and fully verifies both physical route copies, then commits and charges the logical bytes once and the same raw expected bytes independently on each physical route. Under `FINALIZE`, the active lease holder reconciles all appends and seals one exact Attempt Artifact Manifest; Terminal binds its Hash and exact logical and per-route charged bytes. After Terminal commits, each physical route atomically converts its used bytes to an Attempt Payload Retention Charge and releases only unused route capacity. The closed tombstone waits for both exact Charges; only then may reconciliation release unused logical quota. A crash after Manifest seal but before Terminal reuses only that exact sealed Manifest; a crash after Terminal but before both charge conversions, close, or logical release completes only those idempotent same-intent steps. No path overwrites, truncates, unseals, silently drops, pools, expires, renews, or reallocates evidence capacity.
_Avoid_: Best-effort disk space check, shared CI artifact quota, mutable log directory

**Compatibility Custody Attempt Payload Route Reservation**:
The route-specific external quota handle created before Open for exactly one Attempt, one `primary` or `cold` payload route, and exactly 192 MiB of raw expected payload bytes. It binds Routing, Host Fetcher Qualification, CI Policy-selected storage account and quota-generation identity, exact reservation mechanism, Attested Job Identity, and create/read scopes. The mechanism is either a provider-side atomic capacity reservation or an atomically claimed preprovisioned fixed slot of at least 192 MiB that supports exact Attempt suballocation and an atomic split returning every unused byte at Terminal; an unsplittable slot is ineligible even if it could conservatively hold the full capacity. Primary and cold use independently administered capacity and cannot satisfy, borrow, pool, or overcommit one another. Each payload write charges the same logical length to its route. After Terminal, one same-handle atomic transition releases unused capacity and converts all used bytes into the exact Attempt Payload Retention Charge; uncertainty is reconciled by this handle and transition ID only. A free-space observation, optimistic write, shared directory, post-Open allocation, missing support, insufficient capacity, uncertainty, handle mismatch, expiry, renewal requirement, or release-before-Terminal blocks Open or recovery rather than degrading to one copy.
_Avoid_: Aggregate 384-MiB pool, free-space observation, one-route overcommit

**Compatibility Custody Attempt Payload Retention Charge**:
The durable route-specific no-TTL capacity charge produced atomically from one post-Terminal Attempt Payload Route Reservation. It binds route, Attempt, Open, Terminal, permanent Attempt Artifact Manifest and object-set digest, exact storage account, endpoint, quota generation, predecessor Reservation and transition ID, exact used bytes, and suballocated fixed-slot identity when applicable. Unused route bytes release in the same transition; used capacity cannot expire, renew, shrink, transfer, borrow, migrate, or return to a pool while any Manifest-listed payload remains. A successor Routing or storage account may serve new Opens after independent qualification and later Policy selection but never changes or repairs this Charge, path, generation, or Manifest. Qualification must guarantee the bound account and route through prune. Premature decommission, access loss, object loss, or generation disagreement first requires an external Retention Incident Latch, immediately makes that route/account ineligible for ordinary credentials, new Open and Policy selection, freezes every affected prune or Charge release, and then requires its permanent Git Incident Record. Existing work may resume only after a current-tree Retention Incident Recovery Receipt and permanent dual-custody Recovery Evidence Manifest prove the exact original account, endpoint, quota generation, object set, paths and storage generations, fresh qualification applies, and the Latch advances to its checked recovered generation; another account, successor route, rewritten object, restored bytes under a new generation, Manifest rewrite, or peer capacity cannot repair it. An uncertain transition is resolved only by exact Reservation and transition ID, and the Coordination closed tombstone binds the verified primary and cold Charge identities. After one-year retention, each Charge remains until the permanent current-tree Prune Receipt proves every listed object absent on both routes; only then may the corresponding exact capacity suballocation release idempotently. A provider lacking this durable primitive or exact suballocated-slot behavior cannot qualify.
_Avoid_: Renewable storage lease, object lifecycle quota, aggregate retained-byte counter

**Compatibility Custody Retention Latch Challenge**:
The fresh random 128-bit one-use challenge in the Repository Root Incident Lock authority's dedicated retention-challenge namespace for exactly one proposed revocation-only Latch CAS. Before issue, that Authority validates an ordinary current-tree Authorization Proof, current CI Policy and Owner Registry, the exact active Host Fetcher Driver Qualification, one immutable typed Charge in `{attempt_payload, evidence_manifest}`, route, account, endpoint, quota generation and object-set digest, its Attempt/Open/Terminal or Evidence kind/subject/Envelope/Reservation projection, the qualified observer role, one bounded incident Intent, and the exact OIDC Verifier Profile and canonical JWK-set digest; charge-kind, account, route, object-set, subject or role wildcards are forbidden. It binds the exact current Latch predecessor or typed `NO_PREDECESSOR`, trusted issue time and expiry no later than 300 seconds or Proof expiry. The Authority directly validates and atomically consumes one matching protected-CI OIDC token and normalized claims once, deriving a challenge-local attested observer identity without Secret Broker, Coordination verifier slot, credential or Root Boundary Permit because the only possible effect is revocation. Successful consumption authorizes only one exact-generation CAS of that predecessor to the proposed `LATCHED` successor. Replay, token/JWK/claim mismatch, stale qualification, wrong Charge, changed Intent, broader scope, expiry or generation disagreement rejects. The Challenge grants no object read, write, delete, list, credential, Permit, recovery or `RECOVERED` authority; unavailability of the Authority, Proof, Profile or qualification simply leaves ordinary route authority already fail-closed.
_Avoid_: Attestation Challenge, Root Boundary Permit, monitoring webhook secret

**Compatibility Custody Retention Incident Latch**:
The no-TTL append-only linearizable per-Charge revocation state in the Repository Root Incident Lock authority's separate retention namespace. Its first checked generation is typed `NO_PREDECESSOR -> LATCHED`; after an exact `LATCHED -> RECOVERED` successor, a later independent failure may create a new checked `RECOVERED -> LATCHED` generation with a fresh random incident ID. Every latched generation binds exact predecessor and incident ordinal, charge kind and immutable Attempt Payload or Evidence Manifest Route Retention Charge, its Attempt/Open/Terminal or Evidence kind/subject/Envelope/Reservation projection, route/account/endpoint/quota and object-set identities, one successfully consumed Retention Latch Challenge and its challenge-local attested observer, stable incident reason and evidence digests, trusted authority time, and resulting revision. A currently qualified Host Fetcher verification or Artifact Inventory job may request that exact Challenge, but only the Authority's direct OIDC validation and same-intent challenge consumption authorizes the exact predecessor CAS; Owner Approval, Broker, Coordination, ordinary Attestation Challenge and Root Boundary Permit do not participate because the transition grants no authority. Only a duplicate same-incident Intent and consumed Challenge is idempotent, while replay, stale generation, broader account wildcard, changed same-incident reason, unlatch, deletion, timeout or operator clear rejects. `LATCHED` immediately blocks ordinary create/delete/release credentials, payload prune or evidence cleanup, Charge release, new Open and every Policy selecting that route/account; only exact incident evidence reads, isolated requalification and recovery publication remain eligible. The Git Incident Record must later bind that exact Latch generation and Challenge, but delay, outage or failed merge never weakens it. Only after the matching current-tree Recovery Receipt, both permanent Recovery Evidence Manifest copies, fresh qualification, a fresh Current-Tree Authorization Proof and a distinct retention-Latch-recovery Permit fully verify and atomically consume may a checked successor advance that incident to `RECOVERED`; the complete multi-incident history remains permanent, and any current `LATCHED` generation or authority unavailability fails closed.
_Avoid_: Monitoring alert, mutable account disable flag, expiring storage alarm

**Compatibility Custody Retention Incident Record**:
